generic.Defined scope/population: The finalized enterprise product strategy document version tabled for Executive Leadership Team approval.
generic.In-scope period: The strategy horizon covered by the document and the ELT meeting cycle in which it is tabled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Strategy version number, ELT meeting date, decision wording, and attached risk appetite reference all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of voting ELT members recorded present, abstaining, or recused equals the full ELT membership list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval minute filed in the board portal strategy folder with meeting date and strategy version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each condition attached to the approval logged with a named owner, due date, and closure status.
generic.Test population: The ELT approval minute and the published strategy document for the current approval cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any voting member position is unrecorded or the minute omits the strategy version number.
generic.Exception handling path: Unrecorded votes or missing conditions are returned to the ELT secretary for minute correction before filing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval is accepted when minuted against a named strategy version with all voting positions recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Board portal strategy folder holding the signed minute and the approved strategy version.

steps.title: Assemble the ELT approval pack in the board portal
sop: Upload the final strategy document to the board portal with its version number in the file name.
Attach the Board-approved risk appetite statement the strategy was tested against.
Include a decision cover sheet stating the exact resolution wording sought from the ELT.
Done when the pack is lodged in the board portal ahead of the pre-read deadline.
verify: Open the lodged pack and confirm the strategy version matches the version cleared by Finance and Legal.
Pass when the pack contains the strategy, appetite reference, and decision cover sheet.

steps.title: Confirm ELT quorum and voting membership in the board portal
sop: Pull the current ELT membership list from the board portal governance register.
Check each member against the meeting attendance record for present, absent, or delegated status.
Identify any member with a declared interest requiring recusal on this strategy.
Done when quorum is confirmed and every voting member has a recorded status.
verify: Compare the attendance record count against the full ELT membership count.
Pass when no voting member is left without a present, abstaining, or recused status.

steps.title: Table the strategy for decision at the ELT meeting
sop: Present the strategy against the Board-approved risk appetite reference in the pack.
Invite challenge on growth, capital, and customer outcome dimensions before calling the decision.
Call the resolution using the exact wording on the decision cover sheet.
Done when the ELT has voted and the decision is stated in the meeting.
verify: Check the meeting record captures the decision as approved, approved with conditions, or rejected.
Pass when a single unambiguous decision is recorded against the named strategy version.

steps.title: Capture approval conditions in the board portal action log
sop: List every condition the ELT attached to the approval verbatim from the meeting record.
Assign each condition a named owner and a due date agreed in the meeting.
Record each condition in the board portal action log linked to the approval item.
Done when every condition carries an owner and a due date in the action log.
verify: Reconcile the condition count in the action log against the conditions stated in the minute.
Pass when no condition in the minute is missing from the action log.

steps.title: Draft and circulate the approval minute for confirmation
sop: Draft the minute stating the strategy version number, date, decision, and voting positions.
Cite the risk appetite reference the strategy was tested against in the minute body.
Circulate the draft minute to ELT attendees for factual confirmation.
Done when attendees have confirmed the draft minute is factually correct.
verify: Read the draft minute and confirm it names the strategy version and the appetite reference.
Pass when no attendee has an unresolved factual correction outstanding.

steps.title: Retire draft-marked copies from the SharePoint strategy library
sop: Search the SharePoint strategy library for any copy of the strategy marked draft.
Move draft copies to the working folder so they cannot be mistaken for the approved version.
Confirm the version presented as current carries no draft watermark or draft status label.
Done when no draft-marked copy sits in the published strategy location.
verify: Browse the published location using a non-author account and inspect the document status label.
Pass when the only strategy visible as current is the approved, non-draft version.

steps.title: File the signed approval record in the board portal strategy folder
sop: Sign the confirmed minute and upload it to the board portal strategy folder.
Link the minute record to the approved strategy document version in the portal.
Set the retention class on the minute per the governance record retention schedule.
Done when the signed minute is filed and linked to the approved strategy version.
verify: Retrieve the filed minute from the board portal and follow its link to the strategy document.
Pass when the signed minute resolves to the exact approved strategy version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All strategic initiative records in the PPM tool that require a single named accountable owner.
generic.In-scope period: The current strategy cycle covering initiatives active or planned in the approved horizon plan.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Accountable owner, owner acceptance date, delegate name, and funding band are populated on every initiative.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of initiatives with a named owner equals the total initiative count in the PPM tool register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Owner acceptance emails or PPM acknowledgements retained with acceptance timestamp against each initiative.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Initiatives lacking an accepting owner logged with the escalation route and resolution date.
generic.Test population: All active strategic initiative records in the PPM tool for the current strategy cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any initiative names a distribution list, committee, or vacant position as accountable owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Unowned or team-owned initiatives are escalated to the Insurance Product Dev Lead for reassignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment is accepted when each initiative has one named owner with a recorded acceptance timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: PPM tool initiative records plus the SharePoint folder holding owner acceptance correspondence.

steps.title: Extract the strategic initiative list from the PPM tool
sop: Run the strategic initiative report in the PPM tool filtered to the current strategy cycle.
Export the list showing initiative name, funding band, current owner, and status.
Save the extract to SharePoint with the extract date in the file name.
Done when the full initiative population is extracted and saved.
verify: Compare the extract row count against the PPM tool initiative count on screen.
Pass when the extract row count matches the register count for the cycle.

steps.title: Flag initiatives with missing or non-individual owners
sop: Scan the owner column for blanks, distribution lists, committee names, and vacant positions.
Mark each such row as requiring assignment in the working extract.
Cross-check flagged rows against the HR position list to confirm the position is genuinely vacant.
Done when every initiative needing an owner is flagged in the extract.
verify: Filter the extract to flagged rows and inspect each owner value.
Pass when no unflagged row carries a blank or team-level owner value.

steps.title: Test candidate owner seniority against the authority matrix
sop: Open the delegated authority matrix held in the SharePoint governance library.
Match each initiative funding band to the minimum owner seniority the matrix requires.
Reject any candidate whose grade sits below the required band and select an alternative.
Done when every candidate owner meets the seniority required for the funding band.
verify: Sample the highest funding band initiatives and re-check the candidate grade against the matrix.
Pass when no candidate owner sits below the matrix threshold for their initiative.

steps.title: Request owner acceptance by email for each initiative
sop: Send each candidate the initiative scope, funding band, and expected accountabilities.
Ask for explicit acceptance by reply or by acknowledging the PPM tool assignment.
Track outstanding responses and chase candidates who have not replied by the deadline.
Done when every candidate has accepted or formally declined in writing.
verify: Check the acceptance tracker against the flagged initiative list for outstanding replies.
Pass when no initiative is left without a written acceptance or decline.

steps.title: Record accountable owners and delegates in the PPM tool
sop: Populate the accountable owner field with the accepting individual name on each initiative.
Record a backup delegate name for continuity during owner absence.
Stamp the acceptance date into the PPM tool acceptance field for each initiative.
Done when owner, delegate, and acceptance date are populated on every initiative.
verify: Re-run the PPM tool initiative report and check the owner and delegate columns.
Pass when no active initiative shows a blank owner, delegate, or acceptance date.

steps.title: File acceptance evidence in the SharePoint strategy library
sop: Save each acceptance email or PPM acknowledgement under the initiative reference.
Name files with the initiative ID, owner name, and acceptance date.
Apply the governance retention class to the acceptance evidence folder.
Done when acceptance evidence for every initiative is filed and retrievable.
verify: Search the library by initiative ID from a non-author account.
Pass when acceptance evidence is retrievable for every assigned initiative.

steps.title: Review the completed assignment set and close exceptions
sop: Review the final PPM tool owner list against the extracted initiative population.
Confirm every declined or disputed assignment has a resolution recorded.
Escalate any initiative still unowned to the strategy governance forum with a date.
Done when the review is signed and no initiative remains unowned.
verify: Reconcile the count of owned initiatives against the total initiative count.
Pass when the two counts are equal and every exception carries a disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: The roadmap artifact, KPI definition sheet, and accountability matrix supporting the approved product strategy.
generic.In-scope period: The strategy horizons named in the approved enterprise product strategy for the current cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each KPI row carries definition, formula, source system, baseline, target, and target date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Strategic pillar count in the accountability matrix equals the pillar count in the approved strategy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each artifact saved in SharePoint with version number, author, and next review date on the cover.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: KPIs with no available source system logged as gaps with a remediation owner and date.
generic.Test population: All KPI rows, roadmap horizons, and pillar rows across the three governance artifacts.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any KPI row lacks a source system or baseline, or any pillar lacks a responsible and accountable party.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete KPI or pillar rows are returned to the owning function for completion before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Artifacts are accepted when all three exist separately, are versioned, and carry no incomplete rows.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint product strategy governance folder plus the PPM tool records the roadmap artifact feeds.

steps.title: Extract strategy horizons and pillars from the approved strategy
sop: Open the approved strategy in SharePoint and list its horizons and strategic pillars.
Record the exact horizon labels so the roadmap artifact can match them.
Confirm the strategy version used is the version recorded as ELT approved.
Done when horizons and pillars are captured from the approved strategy version.
verify: Compare the captured horizon labels against the strategy document text.
Pass when every horizon and pillar in the strategy appears in the captured list.

steps.title: Build the roadmap artifact in the PPM tool against those horizons
sop: Create the roadmap artifact structure using the captured horizon labels as the columns.
Place each strategic initiative from the PPM tool into its horizon.
Tag every roadmap entry to the strategic pillar it serves.
Done when the roadmap artifact covers all horizons with every entry pillar-tagged.
verify: Filter the roadmap for entries with a blank horizon or blank pillar tag.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Draft the KPI definition sheet in Microsoft Excel
sop: Create one row per KPI with columns for definition, calculation formula, and unit.
Add the source system, baseline value, baseline date, target value, and target date columns.
Populate baselines from the source system rather than from prior presentation decks.
Done when every KPI row is populated across all defined columns.
verify: Apply a filter for blank source system or blank baseline cells.
Pass when no KPI row is missing a source system or a baseline value.

steps.title: Build the accountability matrix for every strategic pillar
sop: Create a matrix row for each strategic pillar captured from the strategy.
Name the responsible party and the accountable party for each pillar.
Cross-check named parties against the PPM tool initiative owner register for consistency.
Done when every pillar has a named responsible and accountable party.
verify: Count matrix rows against the pillar count taken from the approved strategy.
Pass when counts match and no pillar row has a blank responsible or accountable cell.

steps.title: Confirm KPI measurability with the reporting source owners
sop: Send the KPI sheet to each named source system owner for measurability confirmation.
Ask each owner to confirm the formula can be produced from their system as written.
Log any KPI the owner cannot produce as a gap with a remediation owner and date.
Done when every KPI has a measurability confirmation or a logged gap.
verify: Review the confirmation log against the KPI row list.
Pass when no KPI lacks either a confirmation or a logged gap with an owner.

steps.title: Version and publish the three artifacts to SharePoint
sop: Stamp each artifact with a version number, author name, and next review date.
Save all three artifacts as separate deliverables in the governance folder.
Link the artifacts from the strategy landing page so they are found together.
Done when all three versioned artifacts are published in the governance folder.
verify: Open each published artifact and inspect its version, author, and review date.
Pass when all three artifacts exist separately and carry complete version metadata.

steps.title: Review the artifact set against the approved strategy
sop: Check the roadmap horizons match the horizons in the approved strategy exactly.
Confirm the KPI set covers each strategic pillar in the accountability matrix.
Record review comments and reissue where an artifact is inconsistent with the strategy.
Done when the review is recorded and all comments are closed.
verify: Re-read the published artifacts against the strategy after comment closure.
Pass when no horizon, pillar, or KPI inconsistency remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: All divisional product owners and portfolio managers on the strategy stakeholder register.
generic.In-scope period: The communication window running from strategy publication to the acknowledgement deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each recipient row carries name, division, send date, briefing date, and acknowledgement status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Send list recipient count equals the stakeholder register count of product owners and portfolio managers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent communication and acknowledgement log filed in the SharePoint strategy library with send timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recipients not acknowledging by the deadline logged with the chase action and final outcome.
generic.Test population: Every divisional product owner and portfolio manager listed on the stakeholder register.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any register recipient is absent from the send list or has no acknowledgement recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-acknowledging recipients are chased by their divisional lead and escalated if still outstanding.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Communication is accepted when every register recipient is sent to and acknowledgement is captured.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint strategy library folder holding the communication, briefing records, and acknowledgement log.

steps.title: Build the send list from the stakeholder register
sop: Open the stakeholder register in SharePoint and filter to product owners and portfolio managers.
Copy each name and division into the communication send list.
Check the register for recent joiners or leavers and adjust the list accordingly.
Done when the send list carries every register recipient in scope.
verify: Count send list rows against the filtered register row count.
Pass when the two counts match with no register recipient omitted.

steps.title: Draft the communication linking the approved strategy version
sop: Draft the message summarising the strategy decision, horizons, and what changes for divisions.
Insert the SharePoint link to the approved strategy version rather than a working draft.
State the acknowledgement request and the deadline explicitly in the message.
Done when the draft carries the approved version link and the acknowledgement request.
verify: Open the embedded link from a non-author account and inspect the document status.
Pass when the link resolves to the approved version and not a draft copy.

steps.title: Send the communication to the full distribution list
sop: Send the message from Microsoft Teams or Email to every recipient on the send list.
Capture the sent item and delivery report as the send evidence.
Resolve any bounce or delivery failure and resend to the affected recipient.
Done when every recipient has a successful delivery record.
verify: Compare the delivery report against the send list for failures.
Pass when no send list recipient has an unresolved delivery failure.

steps.title: Offer or hold a briefing session for each division
sop: Schedule a Teams briefing per division or offer an existing session slot.
Run the briefing covering strategy implications for that division's portfolio.
Capture attendance from the Teams participant list for each session held.
Done when every division has been offered or held a briefing with attendance logged.
verify: Check the briefing log covers every division named on the send list.
Pass when no division lacks a briefing offer or held session record.

steps.title: Track acknowledgements in the acknowledgement log
sop: Record each acknowledgement reply against the recipient row with the reply date.
Chase recipients with no acknowledgement two working days before the deadline.
Escalate remaining non-responders to their divisional lead after the deadline.
Done when every recipient shows an acknowledgement or a logged escalation.
verify: Filter the acknowledgement log for recipients without a reply date.
Pass when every unacknowledged row carries a recorded escalation action.

steps.title: File the communication and acknowledgement log in SharePoint
sop: Save the sent communication, briefing attendance, and acknowledgement log together.
File them in the strategy library folder for the current strategy version.
Apply the governance retention class to the folder.
Done when the complete communication evidence set is filed in the strategy library.
verify: Retrieve the folder from a non-author account and open each artifact.
Pass when communication, briefing records, and acknowledgement log are all retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All target-state capabilities from the strategy compared against the current in-force product portfolio.
generic.In-scope period: The warehouse extract as-at date used for the current-portfolio baseline in the gap analysis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every gap row carries a size rating, materiality rating, rank, and proposed closure route where ranked top.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portfolio baseline premium in the analysis reconciles to the warehouse premium total for the as-at date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract query text, as-at date, and analysis workbook version retained alongside the gap matrix.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Capabilities that cannot be rated from available data logged with the reason and follow-up owner.
generic.Test population: Every target-state capability row in the gap matrix plus every SWOT entry.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any target-state capability row is unrated or any SWOT entry has no data point or named source.
generic.Exception handling path: Unrated capabilities are referred to the capability owner for evidence before the analysis is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Analysis is accepted when every capability is rated on the agreed scale and gaps are ranked.
generic.Evidence location: The Excel analysis workbook in SharePoint plus the BI report used for the portfolio baseline.

steps.title: Extract the current portfolio baseline from the warehouse
sop: Query the warehouse product and premium tables for the in-force portfolio at a stated as-at date.
Save the query text and the as-at date alongside the extract.
Load the extract into the Excel analysis workbook as the baseline tab.
Done when the baseline tab holds the portfolio extract with its query and as-at date.
verify: Compare the extract premium total against the BI platform portfolio report for the same date.
Pass when the two totals reconcile within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Load target-state capabilities into the gap matrix
sop: List every target-state capability named in the approved strategy as a matrix row.
Record the source strategy section reference against each capability row.
Check no capability from the strategy is omitted from the matrix.
Done when every target-state capability appears as a row in the gap matrix.
verify: Count matrix rows against the capability count in the strategy document.
Pass when the counts match with no capability missing.

steps.title: Rate each capability gap for size and materiality
sop: Apply the agreed rating scale to each capability for gap size against current state.
Apply the same scale for materiality to the strategy outcome.
Use the defined scale values only and avoid free-text ratings.
Done when every capability row carries a size and materiality rating.
verify: Filter the matrix for blank or free-text values in the rating columns.
Pass when no capability row is left unrated or rated outside the scale.

steps.title: Build the SWOT with a source per entry
sop: Draft strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats relevant to the portfolio.
Attach a data point from the warehouse or a named research source to each entry.
Remove or re-source entries that rest only on opinion.
Done when every SWOT entry cites a data point or a named source.
verify: Scan the SWOT source column for blanks and unattributed claims.
Pass when no SWOT entry lacks a data point or named research source.

steps.title: Rank gaps and propose closure routes for the top gaps
sop: Rank capabilities by combined size and materiality rating using the workbook formula.
For each top-ranked gap propose a closure route such as build, buy, or partner.
Record the indicative effort and lead time for each proposed closure route.
Done when the ranked list carries a closure route against each top gap.
verify: Check the ranking recalculates from the rating columns rather than manual ordering.
Pass when the ranked order follows the formula and top gaps all carry closure routes.

steps.title: Review the analysis and publish it to SharePoint
sop: Review the gap matrix, SWOT, and ranking against the strategy target state.
Challenge any rating that is inconsistent with the baseline data and require rework.
Version the workbook and save it to the strategy analysis folder in SharePoint.
Done when the reviewed analysis is versioned and published.
verify: Reopen the published workbook and confirm the query, as-at date, and ratings are intact.
Pass when the published version carries the extract evidence and no unrated rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: The numbered requirement set governing the enterprise product strategy for the current cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The strategy cycle bounded by the current Board-approved risk appetite statement version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every requirement carries a number, testable wording, and a cited appetite clause or corporate objective.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requirement count across growth, capital, customer outcome, and regulatory dimensions covers all four with none empty.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Requirement set saved in SharePoint with version, date, and the appetite statement version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requirements conflicting with stated risk appetite logged in the GRC platform for escalation and decision.
generic.Test population: Every numbered requirement in the requirement set for the current strategy cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any requirement has no source citation or cannot be evidenced as met or not met.
generic.Exception handling path: Appetite conflicts are raised to the accountable product executive and Risk before drafting proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requirements are accepted when signed off by the accountable product executive before drafting starts.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint strategy requirements folder plus the GRC platform record of appetite conflicts.

steps.title: Retrieve the current Board-approved risk appetite statement
sop: Open the GRC platform and locate the risk appetite statement marked current.
Record its version number and approval date for citation in the requirements.
Confirm no later appetite version is pending approval that would supersede it.
Done when the current appetite version and date are captured.
verify: Cross-check the captured version against the GRC platform approval record.
Pass when the cited appetite statement is the current approved version.

steps.title: Draft numbered requirements across the four dimensions
sop: Write requirements covering growth, capital, customer outcome, and regulatory dimensions.
Number each requirement uniquely so it can be referenced downstream.
Phrase each so an assessor can mark it met or not met from evidence.
Done when all four dimensions carry at least one numbered, testable requirement.
verify: Group the requirement list by dimension and inspect coverage.
Pass when no dimension is empty and no requirement is phrased untestably.

steps.title: Cite the appetite clause or objective behind each requirement
sop: For each requirement record the appetite clause or corporate objective it derives from.
Use the clause reference from the current appetite version, not a paraphrase.
Flag any requirement with no traceable source for removal or re-derivation.
Done when every requirement carries a source citation.
verify: Filter the requirement list for blank source citation cells.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Test requirements for conflict with the risk appetite
sop: Compare each requirement against the appetite limits and prohibited activity list.
Mark any requirement that would breach or strain an appetite limit.
Raise each marked requirement in the GRC platform for escalation and decision.
Done when every conflicting requirement carries a GRC escalation record.
verify: Check the GRC platform for an open record against each marked requirement.
Pass when no marked conflict is missing an escalation record.

steps.title: Circulate the requirement set for functional review
sop: Send the numbered requirement set to Finance, Risk, and Compliance reviewers.
Collect comments in a single review log with reviewer name and date.
Disposition each comment as accepted, rejected, or deferred with rationale.
Done when every review comment carries a disposition.
verify: Filter the review log for comments without a disposition.
Pass when no comment is left undispositioned.

steps.title: Obtain executive sign-off and file the requirement set
sop: Present the final requirement set to the accountable product executive for sign-off.
Record the sign-off name, date, and requirement set version.
File the signed set in the SharePoint strategy requirements folder.
Done when the signed requirement set is filed before strategy drafting begins.
verify: Compare the sign-off date against the strategy drafting start date.
Pass when sign-off precedes the drafting start and the version numbers match.

generic.Defined scope/population: The set of product target-state operating capabilities and their supporting KPIs for the strategy horizon.
generic.In-scope period: The target maturity horizon and KPI target dates set in the approved strategy cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each capability carries current maturity, target maturity, at least one KPI, numeric target, and target date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Capability count after deduplication reconciles to the operating model capability list with differences explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Capability and KPI workbook versioned in SharePoint with author and Finance review date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Capabilities with no measurable KPI logged as measurement gaps with an owner and target resolution date.
generic.Test population: Every capability row and every linked KPI row in the target-state definition workbook.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any capability lacks a target maturity or a KPI, or any KPI lacks a named system of record.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmeasurable KPIs are referred to Finance and the reporting owner for redefinition before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Definitions are accepted when Finance confirms measurability and every capability carries a target and KPI.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint target-state capability folder plus the BI platform report proving each KPI source.

steps.title: Draft the target-state capability list in Microsoft Excel
sop: List each product operating capability the strategy target state requires as a row.
Write a one-line definition per capability so scope is unambiguous.
Record the strategy section each capability derives from.
Done when every required capability is listed and defined.
verify: Read the strategy target-state section against the capability list.
Pass when no target-state capability named in the strategy is missing.

steps.title: Deduplicate against the existing operating model capability list
sop: Pull the existing operating model capability list from SharePoint.
Match each draft capability by name and definition against the existing list.
Merge duplicates and record the merge so the lineage is visible.
Done when no draft capability duplicates an existing operating model capability.
verify: Run a name and definition match across both lists.
Pass when no unmerged duplicate pair remains.

steps.title: Rate current and target maturity for each capability
sop: Apply the agreed maturity scale to rate current state for each capability.
Set the target maturity level required by the strategy horizon.
Record the evidence basis for each current-state rating.
Done when every capability carries a current and a target maturity rating.
verify: Filter the workbook for blank current or target maturity cells.
Pass when no capability row is missing either maturity rating.

steps.title: Attach KPIs with numeric targets to each capability
sop: Define at least one KPI per capability with a formula and unit.
Set a numeric target value and a target date for each KPI.
Name the system of record each KPI will be measured from.
Done when every capability has a KPI with target, date, and source system.
verify: Filter KPI rows for blank target, target date, or source system.
Pass when no KPI row is missing any of the three fields.

steps.title: Prove each KPI source on the BI reporting platform
sop: For each KPI locate or build the report in the BI platform that produces it.
Confirm the report returns a value for the stated baseline period.
Log KPIs with no producible report as measurement gaps with an owner.
Done when every KPI is either proven on the BI platform or logged as a gap.
verify: Open each proven KPI report and confirm it returns a value.
Pass when every KPI has a working report or a logged gap with an owner.

steps.title: Obtain Finance review for measurability
sop: Send the capability and KPI set to the Finance business partner for review.
Ask Finance to confirm each KPI is measurable and consistent with financial reporting.
Log Finance comments and rework KPIs Finance cannot support.
Done when Finance has recorded a review outcome on the full KPI set.
verify: Check the Finance review record covers every KPI row.
Pass when no KPI is left without a Finance measurability outcome.

steps.title: Version and publish the capability and KPI set
sop: Stamp the workbook with a version number, author, and review date.
Publish it to the SharePoint target-state capability folder.
Link the published set from the strategy governance landing page.
Done when the versioned set is published and linked.
verify: Open the published workbook from a non-author account.
Pass when the current version is retrievable with all metadata intact.

generic.Defined scope/population: All strategic product initiatives to be sequenced into the multi-year roadmap horizon plan.
generic.In-scope period: The multi-year horizon range H1 to H3 covered by the approved enterprise product strategy.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each roadmap item carries a strategic pillar tag, horizon, indicative delivery year, and dependency links.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Roadmap item count reconciles to the approved initiative count in the PPM tool with differences explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft roadmap saved in the roadmap tool with version number and draft status until governance approval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with unresolved sequencing conflicts logged with the conflict and the proposed resolution.
generic.Test population: Every item on the draft multi-year roadmap for the current strategy cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any roadmap item has no strategic pillar tag or no horizon assignment.
generic.Exception handling path: Untagged or unsequenced items are returned to the initiative owner before governance review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The draft is accepted when every item is pillar-tagged, horizon-assigned, and dependency-linked.
generic.Evidence location: The product roadmap tool draft version plus the SharePoint strategy folder copy.

steps.title: Pull approved strategic initiatives from the PPM tool
sop: Run the approved initiative report in the PPM tool for the strategy cycle.
Export initiative name, owner, funding band, and expected duration.
Save the extract with its run date to SharePoint.
Done when the full approved initiative population is extracted.
verify: Compare the extract count against the PPM tool approved initiative count.
Pass when the counts match for the strategy cycle.

steps.title: Create roadmap items in the roadmap tool
sop: Create one roadmap item per approved initiative in the roadmap tool.
Carry across the owner and funding band from the PPM extract.
Avoid creating items for initiatives already represented on the roadmap.
Done when every approved initiative exists once as a roadmap item.
verify: Match roadmap item names against the PPM extract for duplicates and omissions.
Pass when each initiative appears exactly once.

steps.title: Tag each roadmap item to a strategic pillar
sop: Assign the strategic pillar each item serves using the approved strategy pillar list.
Challenge items that fit no pillar and refer them for a park or reject decision.
Record the pillar tag on the roadmap item field, not in a free-text note.
Done when every roadmap item carries a pillar tag or a park decision.
verify: Filter roadmap items for a blank pillar tag.
Pass when the filter returns no rows without a park decision.

steps.title: Assign horizons and indicative delivery years

steps.title: Insert filing lead times for items needing rate or form filings

steps.title: Record dependencies as explicit predecessor links

steps.title: Version the roadmap as a draft and file it

Export a snapshot to the SharePoint strategy folder for the governance pack.
Circulate the draft to initiative owners for factual correction.

generic.Defined scope/population: The annual product strategy refresh cadence covering review steps, inputs, owners, and dates.

steps.title: Obtain the operating plan and budget calendar dates

Note the plan submission, challenge, and approval dates for the coming year.
Record any fixed board dates the strategy review must precede.
Done when the anchor dates for the cycle are captured.

Pass when every anchor date matches the published calendar.

steps.title: Draft the cadence step sequence with start and finish months
sop: Lay out the refresh steps from performance review through to strategy approval.
Assign a start month and a completion month to each step.
Position the sequence so approval lands before the operating plan submission date.
Done when every step has start and completion months anchored to the calendar.
verify: Trace the sequence end date against the operating plan submission date.

steps.title: List required inputs and owners for each cadence point

steps.title: Create recurring milestones in the PPM tool
sop: Create a recurring milestone for each cadence step in the PPM tool.
Add the pre-read deadline milestone ahead of the strategy review milestone.
Assign the milestone owner to match the cadence table owner.
Done when every cadence step exists as a scheduled PPM milestone.
verify: Count PPM milestones against the cadence table step count.
Pass when counts match and each milestone owner matches the table.

steps.title: Write the cadence into the governance procedure document
sop: Insert the cadence table into the product strategy governance procedure.
State the trigger, inputs, owner, and output for each cadence step.
Version the procedure and record the approval date.
Done when the procedure carries the full cadence and a version stamp.
verify: Read the procedure cadence section against the cadence table.
Pass when the procedure text matches the table with no missing step.

steps.title: Publish the cadence and confirm the next cycle is scheduled
sop: Publish the versioned procedure to the SharePoint governance library.
Notify cadence input owners of their recurring commitments and dates.
Confirm the next cycle milestones appear in the PPM tool forward schedule.
Done when the cadence is published and next-cycle milestones are visible.
verify: Open the PPM forward schedule for the next cycle.
Pass when the strategy refresh milestones appear with owners and dates.

generic.Defined scope/population: The cross-functional strategy workshop series covering C-suite and each divisional leader.
generic.In-scope period: The workshop window running from the first session invitation to the final output note issue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each workshop record carries agenda, pre-read date, attendance, decisions, questions, and actions with owners.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attendee count per session reconciles to the invited C-suite and divisional leader list with substitutes noted.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Agenda, pre-read, attendance list, and output note filed in SharePoint with session dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Absent leaders logged with the substitute attending or the catch-up session scheduled.
generic.Test population: Every workshop held in the series for the current strategy cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any session lacks an agenda, attendance list, or output note, or any action lacks an owner and due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Sessions with insufficient leader coverage are rerun or supplemented with a documented catch-up.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Workshops are accepted when each has agenda, attendance, and outputs recorded with owned actions.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint strategy workshop folder holding agendas, pre-reads, attendance, and output notes.

steps.title: Build the workshop invitation list from the leadership register
sop: List the C-suite members and every divisional leader required for the series.
Record a named substitute for each leader who may be unavailable.
Issue Teams invitations covering the full list for each session.
Done when every required leader or substitute holds an invitation.
verify: Compare the Teams invitee list against the leadership register.
Pass when no required leader is missing from the invitation list.

steps.title: Circulate agenda and pre-read three working days ahead
sop: Draft the session agenda with the decisions the workshop must reach.
Assemble the pre-read pack and save it to the SharePoint workshop folder.
Send agenda and pre-read at least three working days before the session.
Done when agenda and pre-read are sent within the lead-time rule.
verify: Compare the send timestamp against the session date.
Pass when the send precedes the session by at least three working days.

steps.title: Facilitate the workshop and drive to explicit outputs
sop: Run the session against the agenda and hold time for each decision point.
Push each agenda item to a decision, an open question, or an action.
Prevent the session closing with unclassified discussion items.
Done when every agenda item has landed as a decision, question, or action.
verify: Review the in-session capture against the agenda item list.
Pass when no agenda item is left unclassified.

steps.title: Record attendance and substitutions from the Teams roster
sop: Export the Teams participant roster at the end of the session.
Mark each invited leader as attended, substituted, or absent.
Name the substitute where one attended in place of a leader.
Done when every invitee has an attendance status recorded.
verify: Filter the attendance record for invitees with no status.
Pass when every invited leader carries an attendance status.

steps.title: Capture divergent views alongside the consensus position
sop: Record dissenting or divergent views raised in the session with the person raising them.
Keep divergent views in the output note rather than summarising to consensus only.
Mark each divergence as resolved, parked, or requiring follow-up.
Done when every divergent view is recorded with its status.
verify: Read the output note for the divergence section.
Pass when divergent views appear with a named status and are not omitted.

steps.title: Assign owners and due dates to every workshop action
sop: List each action arising from the session in the output note action table.
Assign a named owner and a due date agreed in the session.
Confirm owners accept their actions before the note is issued.
Done when every action carries an accepted owner and due date.
verify: Filter the action table for blank owner or due date cells.
Pass when no action row is missing an owner or a due date.

steps.title: Issue and file the workshop output note
sop: Compile decisions, open questions, actions, and divergences into one output note.
Issue the note to all invitees within the agreed turnaround.
File the agenda, pre-read, attendance, and note together in the workshop folder.
Done when the complete session record is issued and filed.
verify: Retrieve the session folder from a non-author account.
Pass when agenda, attendance list, and output note are all present for the session.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every product idea held in the pipeline register that must be mapped to a strategic growth pillar.
generic.In-scope period: The current strategy cycle covering ideas open in the pipeline register at the mapping date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each idea row carries line of business, growth pillar, target segment, and contribution target.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Mapped idea count equals the open idea count in the pipeline register with no duplicates.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping workbook versioned in Excel with the register extract date recorded on the source tab.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ideas with no pillar fit flagged for a park or reject decision with a named decision maker.
generic.Test population: All idea rows in the pillar mapping workbook for the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any idea row has a blank strategic pillar and no park or reject flag.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmappable ideas are routed to the Insurance Product Manager for a park or reject decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mapping is accepted when every register idea appears once with a pillar, LOB, and segment.
generic.Evidence location: The Excel mapping workbook plus the product roadmap tool idea records it updates.

steps.title: Extract the open idea list from the roadmap tool register
sop: Run the pipeline idea report in the product roadmap tool filtered to open status.
Export idea ID, name, originator, and current stage into Excel.
Record the extract date on the source tab of the mapping workbook.
Done when the full open idea population is loaded into the workbook.
verify: Compare the workbook row count against the roadmap tool open idea count.

steps.title: De-duplicate the idea list before mapping
sop: Sort by idea name and description to surface near-duplicate entries.
Merge duplicates into a single row and record the merged idea IDs.
Confirm no idea appears more than once in the mapping tab.
Done when each idea appears exactly once in the mapping tab.
verify: Run a duplicate check on idea ID and name across the mapping tab.
Pass when no duplicate idea remains unmerged.

steps.title: Tag each idea to a line of business and growth pillar
sop: Assign the line of business the idea would be written in.
Assign the strategic growth pillar the idea is intended to serve.
Use the approved pillar list values only, not free text.
Done when every idea carries an LOB and a pillar value.
verify: Filter for blank or off-list pillar and LOB values.
Pass when no idea row has a blank or invalid pillar or LOB.

steps.title: Record the LOB target the idea contributes to
sop: Pull the LOB premium or growth targets from the approved plan.
Record against each idea the LOB target it is expected to contribute to.
Note an indicative contribution size where an estimate exists.
Done when every mapped idea names the LOB target it supports.
verify: Cross-check recorded targets against the approved plan target list.
Pass when every referenced target exists in the approved plan.

steps.title: Record the intended target customer segment per idea
sop: Assign the customer segment the idea is aimed at from the segment taxonomy.
Flag ideas whose segment cannot be determined for originator follow-up.
Resolve flagged ideas with the originator before finalising the mapping.
Done when every idea carries a target segment or a resolved follow-up.
verify: Filter for ideas with no segment value.
Pass when no idea is left without a segment or a closed follow-up.

steps.title: Flag no-fit ideas for a park or reject decision
sop: Review ideas that could not be tagged to any strategic pillar.

Record the decision maker name and decision date on each flagged idea.
Done when every no-fit idea carries a park or reject decision.
verify: Filter for ideas with a blank pillar and inspect the decision column.
Pass when every such idea carries a park or reject decision with a date.

steps.title: Write the mapping back to the roadmap tool idea records
sop: Update each idea record in the roadmap tool with pillar, LOB, and segment.
Apply park or reject status where the mapping decided it.
Attach the mapping workbook version to the register for traceability.
Done when the roadmap tool reflects the completed mapping.
verify: Re-run the roadmap tool idea report and inspect the pillar column.
Pass when no open idea in the tool lacks a pillar or a park decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: All corporate strategic objectives and the product portfolio themes mapped against them.
generic.In-scope period: The corporate strategy release currently in force and the portfolio theme set derived from it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each mapping row carries objective reference, portfolio theme, objective measure moved, and theme owner.

steps.title: Extract the corporate objectives from the current strategy release

Confirm no later corporate strategy release supersedes the one used.
Done when all objectives from the current release are listed with references.

Pass when every objective in the release appears in the list.

steps.title: List the product portfolio themes in the mapping workbook
sop: Pull the current portfolio theme set from the product strategy governance folder.
Enter each theme with its description as a mapping column or row.
Remove retired themes so only live themes are mapped.
Done when the live theme set is loaded into the mapping workbook.
verify: Compare the loaded themes against the governance theme register.
Pass when only live themes appear and none is missing.

steps.title: Map each objective to its supporting portfolio themes
sop: For each objective identify the themes that materially advance it.
Record each objective-to-theme link as a mapping row.
Avoid mapping a theme to an objective it only indirectly touches.
Done when every objective has its supporting themes recorded.

Pass when every objective either has a theme link or moves to the gap step.

sop: Move each unmapped objective into an explicit coverage gap list.

Assign an owner and a review date to each coverage gap.
Done when every unmapped objective sits on the coverage gap list with an owner.
verify: Add the mapped objective count to the coverage gap count.
Pass when the total equals the corporate objective count.

steps.title: Record the objective measure each theme moves
sop: For each theme name the objective measure it is expected to move.

Flag themes that cannot name a measure for redefinition.
Done when every theme names an objective measure or is flagged.
verify: Filter theme rows for a blank objective measure.
Pass when no theme row is blank without a redefinition flag.

steps.title: Reconcile theme owners against the initiative owner register
sop: Record the named owner for each portfolio theme.
Compare each theme owner against the PPM initiative owner register.
Resolve mismatches with the Insurance Product Manager before publication.
Done when every theme owner matches the initiative owner register.
verify: Run a name match between theme owners and register owners.
Pass when no theme owner is absent from or inconsistent with the register.

steps.title: Version, date, and publish the mapping to SharePoint
sop: Stamp the workbook with a version number and the mapping date.
Cite the corporate strategy release version the mapping reflects.
Publish the workbook to the SharePoint strategy mapping folder.
Done when the versioned mapping is published with its strategy release citation.
verify: Open the published workbook and check the release citation.
Pass when the cited release is the current corporate strategy release.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved enterprise product strategy document and its publication locations in SharePoint and Confluence.

steps.title: Retrieve the approved strategy file recorded in the minute
sop: Open the approval minute and note the approved strategy version number.

Record its checksum or file properties for comparison after publication.
Done when the approved file version is retrieved and its properties recorded.

steps.title: Archive the previous strategy version as superseded

Remove the prior version from any location presented as current.

sop: Upload the approved file to the published strategy folder without editing it.

Set the document status label to approved and current.
Done when the published file matches the approved version exactly.
verify: Compare the published file properties against the pre-publication record.
Pass when the published file is identical to the approved version.

steps.title: Create the Confluence strategy page with approval metadata
sop: Create or update the Confluence strategy page for the current version.
Show approval date, approver name, version number, and next review date on the page.
Link the page to the SharePoint published file rather than duplicating content.
Done when the Confluence page carries full approval metadata and the file link.
verify: Read the Confluence page header for the four metadata items.
Pass when approval date, approver, version, and next review date are all shown.

steps.title: Set read permissions for all product and portfolio staff
sop: Set the SharePoint folder and Confluence page permissions to the product and portfolio groups.
Confirm the groups used cover every division named on the stakeholder register.
Remove any restrictive inherited permission blocking those groups.
Done when the intended audience holds read access to both locations.
verify: Open both locations from a non-author account in the audience group.
Pass when the account can read the strategy in both locations.

steps.title: Announce publication with a resolving link
sop: Draft the announcement stating the version, approval date, and where to find it.
Insert the Confluence page link and test it before sending.
Send the announcement to the strategy stakeholder distribution list.
Done when the announcement is sent with a tested resolving link.
verify: Open the announcement link from a non-author account.

generic.Defined scope/population: The draft enterprise product strategy submitted to Finance for capital review and Legal for regulatory feasibility.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reviews are complete when both signed memos exist against the same version with all comments dispositioned.

steps.title: Issue the versioned draft to Finance and Legal
sop: Fix the draft version number and lock the file against further edits during review.
Send the draft to the Finance business partner and the Legal reviewer with the review scope.
State the return date and the memo format required from each function.

steps.title: Obtain the Finance view on capital and expense implications
sop: Chase Finance for a written view covering capital and expense implications.

Reconcile any figures Finance cites against the ERP general ledger source.
Done when a written Finance view is received covering capital and expense.

steps.title: Obtain the Legal view on regulatory feasibility per jurisdiction
sop: Request a written Legal view covering each target jurisdiction in the strategy.
Confirm the memo names the jurisdictions assessed and those not assessed.
Record regulatory feasibility findings in the GRC platform against the strategy record.
Done when a written Legal view covering the target jurisdictions is received.
verify: Compare the jurisdictions in the Legal memo against the strategy target list.
Pass when every target jurisdiction is addressed or explicitly excluded.

steps.title: Log every review comment with an accept or reject disposition
sop: Transcribe each comment from both memos into a single disposition log.
Set each comment to accepted, rejected, or deferred with a written rationale.
Reference the strategy section each comment affects.
Done when every comment carries a disposition and rationale.
verify: Count log rows against the comment count in both memos.

steps.title: Resolve items Legal flags as not feasible

Done when every not-feasible item is removed or carries a documented mitigation.
verify: Search the revised strategy text for each not-feasible item.

steps.title: Confirm both memos are dated to the same draft version
sop: Check the version number and date on the Finance and Legal memos.

Record the confirmed version alignment in the review log header.
Done when both signed memos cite the same draft version and date range.
verify: Read the version citation on each signed memo.
Pass when both memos cite the identical draft version.

steps.title: File the signed memos and closed disposition log
sop: Save both signed memos and the closed disposition log to the review folder.

Apply the governance retention class to the review evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: At least three named competitors analysed on coverage, limits, exclusions, and price position for the target product.

steps.title: Collect competitor coverage, limits, and exclusions

steps.title: Collect competitor rate points from permitted sources only

Reject any data obtained by misrepresentation or an improper channel.

steps.title: List explicit feature gaps versus our current product

Done when every attribute difference is listed as an explicit gap row.

steps.title: Peer review and publish the competitive analysis

steps.title: Upload artifacts to the document management repository
sop: Create or open the opportunity folder in the document management repository.
Upload every inventory artifact into the folder.
Record the upload timestamp against each inventory row.
Done when every inventory artifact is uploaded to the opportunity folder.

Pass when the counts match with no artifact missing.

steps.title: Apply the product research retention class

steps.title: Remove sole copies from personal and SharePoint working areas

steps.title: Test retrieval from a non-author account

Pass when all inventory artifacts are retrievable under the opportunity ID.

generic.Defined scope/population: The identified opportunity tested line by line against documented risk appetite and delivery capacity by LOB and geography.
generic.In-scope period: The appetite statement version in force and the capacity planning horizon for the opportunity launch window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each appetite line carries an in or out of appetite result, and each capacity constraint carries a quantified figure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Appetite lines tested equal the appetite statement line count applicable to the LOB and geography.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment workbook versioned with the cited appetite statement version and warehouse extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Elements falling outside appetite logged with the escalation route and the proceed, condition, or decline outcome.
generic.Test population: Every appetite line and every named capacity constraint in the assessment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any capacity constraint is recorded without a quantified figure or an appetite line is untested.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-appetite elements are escalated through the GRC platform to Risk for a documented decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment is accepted when it records proceed, proceed-with-conditions, or decline with rationale.
generic.Evidence location: The Excel assessment workbook in SharePoint plus the GRC platform appetite escalation records.

steps.title: Retrieve the current appetite statement from the GRC platform
sop: Open the GRC platform and locate the risk appetite statement marked current.
Filter it to the lines of business and geographies the opportunity targets.
Record the appetite version number and approval date for citation.
Done when the applicable appetite lines and version are captured.
verify: Check the captured version against the GRC current record.
Pass when the assessment cites the current approved appetite version.

steps.title: Test the opportunity against each appetite line
sop: Assess each applicable appetite line against the opportunity as scoped.
Mark each line as within appetite, at limit, or outside appetite.
Record the reasoning for any at-limit or outside-appetite result.
Done when every applicable appetite line carries a tested result.
verify: Count tested lines against the applicable appetite line count.
Pass when no applicable appetite line is left untested.

steps.title: Screen the opportunity against the prohibited risk list
sop: Open the no-write and prohibited risk list held in the GRC platform.
Compare each element of the opportunity against the prohibited entries.
Flag any match immediately for escalation before further work.
Done when every opportunity element is screened against the prohibited list.
verify: Review the screening record for unscreened opportunity elements.
Pass when no element remains unscreened and no unescalated match exists.

steps.title: Quantify underwriting and reinsurance capacity
sop: Pull current utilised and available capacity from the warehouse exposure data.
Express available underwriting and reinsurance capacity in premium or limit terms.
Record the extract date and query behind each capacity figure.
Done when available capacity is quantified in premium or limit terms.
verify: Reconcile the capacity figures against the warehouse exposure extract.
Pass when every capacity figure ties to a dated warehouse extract.

steps.title: Quantify delivery capacity constraints by named team
sop: Collect capacity positions from product, actuarial, IT, and filings teams.
Express each constraint in effort days or FTE for the launch window.
Name the team accountable for each constraint recorded.
Done when every delivery constraint is quantified and attributed to a team.
verify: Filter constraints for missing quantities or missing team names.
Pass when no constraint is recorded without a figure and an owning team.

steps.title: Escalate out-of-appetite elements through the GRC platform
sop: Raise a GRC record for each element outside appetite or on the prohibited list.
Attach the appetite test result and the business rationale for consideration.
Track each record to a documented Risk decision.
Done when every out-of-appetite element carries a GRC record and decision.
verify: Check the GRC platform for open records against flagged elements.
Pass when no flagged element is missing an escalation record.

steps.title: Record the appetite conclusion and file the assessment
sop: State the conclusion as proceed, proceed-with-conditions, or decline with rationale.
List any conditions with owners and the stage gate they must be met by.
Version the workbook and file it against the opportunity in SharePoint.
Done when the conclusion and conditions are recorded and filed.
verify: Open the filed assessment and read the conclusion section.
Pass when a single explicit conclusion with rationale is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: All target jurisdictions and competitive factors constraining the opportunity as scoped in the concept brief.
generic.In-scope period: The filing and licensing position in force at the assessment date across the target jurisdictions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each jurisdiction row carries filing requirement, approval lead time, licensing status, and constraint rating.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Jurisdiction rows in the constraint analysis equal the target jurisdiction list in the concept brief.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Constraint analysis recorded in the GRC platform with assessment date and the regulation references cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Constraints rated as blockers logged with the mitigation owner and the decision on whether to proceed.
generic.Test population: Every target jurisdiction and every identified regulatory or competitive constraint.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any target jurisdiction is omitted or any constraint lacks a blocker or manageable rating.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocker-rated constraints are escalated to Compliance and the product executive before design proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Analysis is accepted when every jurisdiction is covered and every constraint is rated with an owner.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform constraint record plus the SharePoint opportunity folder analysis document.

steps.title: List the target jurisdictions from the concept brief
sop: Open the concept brief in SharePoint and extract the target jurisdiction list.
Create one analysis row per jurisdiction and line combination.
Confirm the list with the Insurance Product Manager before analysis begins.
Done when every target jurisdiction has an analysis row.
verify: Compare analysis rows against the brief jurisdiction list.
Pass when no target jurisdiction is omitted from the analysis.

steps.title: Record rate and form filing requirements per jurisdiction
sop: Look up the rate and form filing requirement for each jurisdiction in the GRC platform.
Record whether filing is prior approval, file and use, or exempt.
Capture the expected approval lead time for each jurisdiction.
Done when every jurisdiction row states its filing requirement and lead time.
verify: Filter for jurisdiction rows without a filing requirement or lead time.
Pass when no jurisdiction row is missing either field.

steps.title: Check licensing status for each jurisdiction and line
sop: Query the licence register in the GRC platform for each jurisdiction and line.
Record licensed, not licensed, or licence application required.
Note the lead time where a new or amended licence is required.
Done when licensing status is recorded for every jurisdiction and line.
verify: Cross-check a sample of statuses against the licence register entries.
Pass when the recorded status matches the register for every sampled row.

steps.title: Identify product oversight and governance obligations
sop: Identify product oversight and governance rules applicable to the concept.
Record the target market, distribution, and review obligations they impose.
Reference the specific regulation or rule in the GRC platform record.
Done when applicable oversight obligations are identified and referenced.
verify: Check each recorded obligation cites a regulation reference.
Pass when no obligation is recorded without a rule reference.

steps.title: Document competitive constraints on market entry
sop: Identify incumbent exclusivity, distribution lock-in, or panel restrictions in the target market.
Record each competitive constraint with the evidence source and date.
State the practical effect on our ability to distribute the product.
Done when every known competitive constraint is documented with a source.
verify: Filter competitive constraint rows for blank source citations.
Pass when every competitive constraint cites a dated source.

steps.title: Rate every constraint and assign a mitigation owner
sop: Rate each regulatory and competitive constraint as blocker or manageable.
Assign a named mitigation owner and a target resolution date to each.
Escalate blocker-rated constraints to Compliance and the product executive.
Done when every constraint carries a rating, owner, and escalation where needed.
verify: Filter the constraint list for blank ratings or owners.
Pass when no constraint lacks a rating and a mitigation owner.

steps.title: Record the constraint analysis in the GRC platform
sop: Load the completed constraint analysis into the GRC platform against the opportunity.
Attach the supporting analysis document from the SharePoint opportunity folder.
Set the review date so constraints are re-tested before the design gate.
Done when the analysis is recorded in the GRC platform with a review date.
verify: Open the GRC record and check the jurisdiction rows and attachment.
Pass when the record is complete and the attachment opens.

generic.Defined scope/population: The product owner assignment for the named opportunity recorded on the pipeline register.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of active opportunities with a named owner equals the count of active opportunities in the register.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined assignments logged with the reason and the replacement owner appointed.
generic.Test population: The opportunity record in the pipeline register and the owner acceptance evidence.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the opportunity is active without an assigned owner or the prior owner field is left open.
