Pass when the captured amount and conditions match the minute.

steps.title: Draft the notification with the amount and effective date
sop: Draft the notification stating the approved funding amount.
State the effective date from which funding is available.
Cite the committee minute or decision reference.
Done when the draft states amount, effective date, and reference.
verify: Compare the draft amount against the recorded decision.
Pass when the figures are identical.

steps.title: Restate every approval condition in full
sop: Copy each condition from the decision record verbatim into the notification.
Avoid summarising or paraphrasing any condition.
Include the owner and due date attached to each condition.
Done when every condition appears in full in the notification.
verify: Compare the notification conditions word for word against the decision.
Pass when no condition is abbreviated or omitted.

steps.title: Confirm the recipient list covers owner and line manager
sop: Identify the named product owner from the initiative record.
Identify the owner line manager from the organisation directory.
Add both to the notification recipient list.
Done when both recipients are on the send list.
verify: Read the recipient list against the initiative owner record.
Pass when the named owner and their line manager are both included.

steps.title: Send the notification and confirm delivery
sop: Send the notification from Microsoft Teams or Email.
Check for delivery failures and resend where needed.
Record the send timestamp.
Done when both recipients have confirmed delivery.
verify: Check the delivery report for both recipients.
Pass when neither recipient has an unresolved delivery failure.

steps.title: File the notification against the initiative record
sop: Attach the sent notification to the initiative record in the PPM tool.
Link it to the approval decision entry.
Record the filing date on the initiative record.
Done when the notification is filed and linked as evidence.
verify: Open the initiative record and retrieve the attached notification.
Pass when the notification is retrievable with its funding amount and conditions.

generic.Defined scope/population: The initiative tested for alignment against the current annual operating plan cost, benefit, and timing lines.
generic.In-scope period: The current plan year plus any delivery period extending beyond it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan line reference, plan cost, business case cost, benefit reflection, timing difference, and Finance agreement are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Initiative cost in the business case equals the amount held on the operating plan line or the difference is explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Alignment confirmation retained in SharePoint with the Finance partner name, date, and plan version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: In-year additions not in the plan logged explicitly with the approval route for the addition.
generic.Test population: The initiative cost, benefit, and timing entries against the operating plan lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no matching plan line exists and the initiative is not recorded as an in-year addition.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched initiatives are escalated to the Finance business partner for an in-year addition decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Alignment is accepted when a documented confirmation names the Finance partner and the date.
generic.Evidence location: ERP general ledger plan lines, the PPM initiative record, and the SharePoint confirmation record.

steps.title: Locate the initiative in the annual operating plan
sop: Search the annual operating plan for the initiative or its programme line.
Record the plan line reference where a match exists.
Mark the initiative as an in-year addition where no line exists.
Done when the plan line is identified or the addition is recorded.
verify: Check the recorded plan line exists in the current plan version.
Pass when the reference resolves or the addition is explicitly recorded.

steps.title: Compare business case cost against the plan line amount
sop: Extract the plan line amount from the ERP general ledger.
Compare it against the business case initiative cost.
Quantify and explain any difference.
Done when the two amounts are compared and the difference explained.
verify: Read the comparison difference figure.
Pass when the difference is zero or documented with a reason.

steps.title: Check benefits are reflected in plan premium or expense targets
sop: Identify the premium or expense targets the initiative benefits should move.
Confirm the plan targets include those benefits.
Flag benefits not reflected anywhere in the plan.
Done when benefit reflection in the plan is confirmed or flagged.
verify: Trace each stated benefit to a plan target line.
Pass when every benefit is reflected or explicitly flagged.

steps.title: Document timing differences between plan and delivery
sop: Compare the delivery schedule against the plan year phasing.
Record any spend or benefit falling outside the plan year.
State how the timing difference will be handled.
Done when timing differences are documented with their handling.
verify: Read the timing section against the delivery schedule.
Pass when every out-of-year element is documented.

steps.title: Obtain the Finance business partner agreement
sop: Send the alignment check to the Finance business partner for confirmation.
Ask for written agreement that the check is correct.
Record the partner name and the confirmation date.
Done when written Finance agreement is received and recorded.
verify: Read the confirmation for the partner name and date.
Pass when both are recorded on the confirmation.

steps.title: File the alignment confirmation with the initiative
sop: Attach the confirmation to the PPM initiative record.
Save a copy to the SharePoint business case folder.
Note the plan version the confirmation relates to.
Done when the confirmation is filed and linked to the initiative.
verify: Open the initiative record and retrieve the confirmation.
Pass when the confirmation is retrievable with partner name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The required investment in systems, regulatory filings, and operations for the product initiative.
generic.In-scope period: The investment horizon covering one-off build costs and the recurring run costs after launch.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every cost line carries an owning function, one-off or recurring flag, value, and basis of estimate.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One-off plus recurring totals plus contingency equal the headline investment figure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Estimate workbook versioned in SharePoint with the IT scope document and ERP rate references cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cost lines with no owning function logged with the escalation route and the resolution date.
generic.Test population: Every cost line in the investment estimate workbook.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any cost line has no owning function named or contingency is not stated explicitly.
generic.Exception handling path: Unowned cost lines are referred to the delivery lead for ownership before the estimate is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The estimate is accepted when one-off and recurring totals are shown separately with stated contingency.
generic.Evidence location: The Excel estimate workbook plus the PPM tool estimate record and ERP cost rate references.

steps.title: Define the system change scope for IT estimation
sop: Write the system change scope covering policy, billing, and claims impacts.
Send the scope to IT for a cost estimate against it.
Record the scope version the IT estimate was produced against.
Done when IT returns an estimate against a defined scope.
verify: Compare the IT estimate reference against the scope version.
Pass when the estimate cites the defined scope rather than an assumption.

steps.title: Estimate filing costs per target jurisdiction
sop: List the target jurisdictions and their filing fee schedules.
Add the internal effort cost for preparing each filing.
Record the fee source and the effort basis per jurisdiction.
Done when filing costs cover fees and internal effort per jurisdiction.
verify: Filter filing cost lines for missing fee or effort components.
Pass when every jurisdiction shows both fee and effort.

steps.title: Estimate operational set-up costs
sop: Estimate training, servicing set-up, and claims handling set-up costs.
Source unit costs from the ERP general ledger where available.
Name the operational function that owns each cost line.
Done when operational set-up costs are estimated with owning functions.
verify: Filter operational cost lines for blank owning functions.
Pass when no operational cost line is unowned.

steps.title: Separate one-off from recurring costs
sop: Flag each cost line as one-off or recurring.
Total one-off and recurring costs separately.
Show recurring costs on an annualised basis.
Done when one-off and recurring totals are separately shown.
verify: Sum the flagged lines against the separate totals.
Pass when the totals reconcile to the flagged cost lines.

steps.title: State and justify the contingency percentage
sop: Set the contingency percentage based on the estimate confidence.
State the percentage explicitly rather than embedding it in line items.
Record the justification for the percentage chosen.
Done when contingency is stated explicitly with a justification.
verify: Read the contingency line and its justification.
Pass when the percentage is explicit and justified.

steps.title: Load the estimate into the PPM tool and reconcile
sop: Enter the investment estimate into the PPM initiative record.
Confirm the PPM total matches the workbook headline figure.
Version the workbook and file it in SharePoint.
Done when the PPM estimate matches the filed workbook.
verify: Compare the PPM total against the workbook headline figure.
Pass when the two figures are identical.

generic.Defined scope/population: The board comments on the business case and the revised case produced in response to them.
generic.In-scope period: The revision window between the board session and the resubmission deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each board comment carries the analysis performed, the response, and the change made or the reason for none.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Change log entry count equals the count of numbers and sections changed after feedback.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revised case versioned in SharePoint with a version number differing from the board-reviewed version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Comments the team disagrees with logged with a reasoned written response rather than silent omission.
generic.Test population: Every board comment recorded from the session and every change in the revised case.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any board comment has no documented response or a changed number is not re-reconciled.
generic.Exception handling path: Unanswered comments block resubmission until a documented response is produced.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The revision is accepted when a change log identifies each revision made after board feedback.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint business case folder holding the comment log, change log, and revised workbook.

steps.title: Transcribe each board comment individually
sop: Read the board minute and list each comment as a separate row.
Record who raised it and which case section it affects.
Avoid grouping several comments into one row.
Done when every board comment is listed individually.
verify: Count the comment rows against the minute comments.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Perform the additional analysis each comment requires
sop: For each comment identify the analysis needed to answer it.
Run the analysis using the actuarial or financial model as appropriate.
Record the analysis performed against the comment row.
Done when every comment has its analysis recorded.
verify: Filter the comment log for rows with no analysis recorded.
Pass when no comment lacks a recorded analysis.

steps.title: Re-reconcile changed numbers to their source models
sop: Identify every figure that changed as a result of the analysis.
Re-run the reconciliation to the sizing, pricing, or expense source model.
Record the reconciliation result against each changed figure.
Done when every changed figure is re-reconciled to its source.
verify: Read the reconciliation results for the changed figures.
Pass when every changed figure ties back to its source model.

steps.title: Record reasoned responses to comments the team disputes
sop: Identify comments the team does not agree with.
Write a reasoned response explaining why no change is being made.
Include these responses in the resubmission rather than omitting them.
Done when every disputed comment carries a reasoned response.
verify: Filter disputed comments for blank responses.
Pass when no disputed comment is left without a reasoned response.

steps.title: Build the change log for the revised case
sop: List every change made to the case with its section reference.
Record the board comment that drove each change.
State what moved and by how much for numeric changes.
Done when the change log covers every revision made.
verify: Compare the change log against the tracked changes in the case.
Pass when every revision appears in the change log.

steps.title: Version the revised case distinctly from the reviewed version
sop: Increment the business case version number.
Confirm the new version number differs from the board-reviewed version.
File the revised case and change log in SharePoint.
Done when the revised case carries a distinct version and is filed.
verify: Compare the revised version number against the board-reviewed version.
Pass when the two version numbers differ.

generic.Defined scope/population: The formal product development workstream opened after funding approval for the initiative.
generic.In-scope period: The workstream lifecycle from opening to the next stage gate, starting on or after the approval date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Funding code, charter, scope, owner, milestones, success measures, cadence, and escalation route are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Milestones baselined in the delivery tool match the milestones in the charter with no divergence.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Charter and RAID log filed in SharePoint with the workstream open date recorded in the PPM tool.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known risks carried from the business case logged in the RAID log with owners at opening.
generic.Test population: The workstream record, charter, RAID log, and kick-off attendance.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the workstream open date precedes the recorded funding approval date.
generic.Exception handling path: Workstreams opened early are corrected and the sequence documented before delivery proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Opening is accepted when funding code, charter, and baselined milestones are all in place.
generic.Evidence location: PPM tool workstream record, Jira Align delivery structure, and the SharePoint charter folder.

steps.title: Confirm the funding approval date and code
sop: Retrieve the funding approval record and note the approval date.
Obtain the approved funding code or budget line from Finance.
Confirm no workstream activity is booked before the approval date.
Done when the funding date and code are confirmed.
verify: Compare the intended workstream open date against the approval date.
Pass when the open date is on or after the approval date.

steps.title: Create the workstream with the funding code attached
sop: Create the workstream in the PPM tool and in Jira Align.
Attach the approved funding code to the workstream record.
Set the workstream open date to the agreed start.
Done when the workstream exists with the funding code attached.
verify: Open the workstream record and read the funding code field.
Pass when the funding code matches the approval record.

steps.title: Write the workstream charter
sop: Write the charter naming scope, owner, key milestones, and success measures.
Reference the approved business case and its version.
Circulate the charter to the delivery functions for confirmation.
Done when the charter names scope, owner, milestones, and measures.
verify: Read the charter for the four required elements.
Pass when none of the four is missing.

steps.title: Define the reporting cadence and escalation route
sop: Set the reporting frequency and the forum reports go to.
Define the escalation route and the thresholds that trigger it.
Record both in the charter and the PPM workstream record.
Done when cadence and escalation route are defined and recorded.
verify: Read the charter cadence and escalation sections.
Pass when both are explicitly defined.

steps.title: Open the RAID log with known business case risks
sop: Create the RAID log for the workstream in the PPM tool.
Load the risks already identified in the business case.
Assign an owner and a mitigation to each loaded risk.
Done when the RAID log holds the known risks with owners.
verify: Compare RAID entries against the business case risk section.
Pass when every business case risk appears in the RAID log.

steps.title: Hold the kick-off with all delivery functions
sop: Invite product, actuarial, IT, and distribution representatives.
Run the kick-off covering charter, milestones, and RAID.
Record attendance and any actions arising with owners.
Done when the kick-off is held with all four functions represented.
verify: Check the kick-off attendance against the four functions.
Pass when each function is represented in the attendance record.

steps.title: Baseline the workstream milestones
sop: Enter the charter milestones into the delivery tool.
Baseline the milestone dates so slippage can be measured.
Confirm the baselined set matches the charter.
Done when the workstream milestones are baselined.
verify: Compare the baselined milestones against the charter list.
Pass when the two sets match exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: Base, optimistic, and adverse scenarios for revenue and profitability outcomes of the initiative.
generic.In-scope period: The business case projection horizon over which each scenario is run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each scenario states its assumption changes for volume, price, loss cost, and expense, plus its outputs.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Base scenario outputs reconcile to the business case headline figures without adjustment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scenario workbook versioned with actuarial platform outputs and the warehouse extract date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Scenarios breaching the hurdle rate identified with the probability discussion recorded.
generic.Test population: Every scenario and every flexed driver in the scenario model.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any scenario is produced by a single unexplained adjustment factor.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained adjustment factors are decomposed into named driver changes before the scenarios are issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scenarios are accepted when a documented assumption set distinguishes base, optimistic, and adverse cases.
generic.Evidence location: The Excel scenario workbook, the actuarial modelling platform outputs, and the warehouse extracts.

steps.title: Confirm the base scenario ties to the business case
sop: Load the business case assumptions as the base scenario.
Run the model and compare outputs to the business case headline figures.
Resolve any difference before building the other scenarios.
Done when the base scenario reproduces the business case outputs.
verify: Compare base scenario outputs against the business case.
Pass when the two agree without manual adjustment.

steps.title: Define the driver changes for each scenario
sop: State the volume, price, loss cost, and expense change for each scenario.
Make each driver independently flexible in the model.
Avoid using a single blended adjustment factor.
Done when each scenario states its four driver changes.
verify: Inspect the scenario tab for four independently flexed drivers.
Pass when no scenario relies on one unexplained factor.

steps.title: Build the adverse scenario with a worse loss ratio and slower ramp
sop: Set a materially worse loss ratio using an adverse actuarial indication.
Set a slower volume ramp reflecting slow market acceptance.
Run the adverse case on the actuarial modelling platform.
Done when the adverse scenario reflects both a worse loss ratio and slower ramp.
verify: Compare the adverse loss ratio and ramp against the base case.
Pass when both are materially worse than base.

steps.title: Build the optimistic scenario on evidenced upside
sop: Set upside drivers using evidenced upper bounds from comparable launches.
Avoid setting an upside that no comparable supports.
Record the evidence behind each upside driver.
Done when the optimistic scenario drivers are evidenced.
verify: Read the evidence recorded against each upside driver.
Pass when every upside driver cites a comparable or benchmark.

steps.title: Show profitability and payback for each case
sop: Output profit and payback for each scenario, not revenue alone.
Present the three cases side by side for comparison.
Confirm outputs recalculate from the driver cells.
Done when each scenario shows profitability and payback.
verify: Check each scenario column for profit and payback outputs.
Pass when no scenario shows revenue only.

steps.title: Identify the scenario that breaches the hurdle rate
sop: Compare each scenario return against the hurdle rate.
Identify the scenario at which the hurdle is breached.
Record the discussion of how likely that scenario is.
Done when the breaching scenario and its likelihood are recorded.
verify: Read the hurdle comparison and the likelihood discussion.
Pass when the breaching scenario is identified with a likelihood view.

generic.Defined scope/population: The pricing assumptions and loss development factors used in the business case requiring actuarial sign-off.
generic.In-scope period: The business case model version and the reserving period the loss development factors derive from.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Sign-off names the assumptions covered, the model version, limitations, conditions, and the signing actuary.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assumption values in the business case match the values in the signed memo exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed memo filed in SharePoint citing the business case model version and the sign-off date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Data gaps and limitations logged in the memo with the condition attached to the opinion.
generic.Test population: Every pricing assumption and loss development factor referenced in the business case.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any signed assumption differs from the business case figure or the signing authority is insufficient.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatched assumptions are corrected and the memo reissued against the corrected model version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off is accepted when the signed memo cites the model version and states its limitations.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint sign-off folder memo plus the actuarial modelling platform outputs it references.

steps.title: List the assumptions and factors requiring sign-off
sop: Extract the pricing assumptions and loss development factors from the business case.
Record the value and the model cell reference for each.
Note the business case model version being signed.
Done when the sign-off scope list is complete with values.
verify: Compare the list against the business case assumption register.
Pass when every pricing assumption and factor is included.

steps.title: Trace loss development factors to the reserving basis
sop: Trace each loss development factor to the reserving basis or a stated benchmark.
Run the supporting analysis on the actuarial modelling platform.
Record the traceability reference against each factor.
Done when every factor is traceable to a reserving basis or benchmark.
verify: Read the traceability reference against each factor.
Pass when no factor is untraceable to a stated basis.

steps.title: State limitations, data gaps, and conditions
sop: List the limitations and data gaps affecting the opinion.
State the conditions under which the opinion holds.
Avoid issuing an unqualified opinion where gaps exist.
Done when limitations and conditions are stated in the memo.
verify: Read the memo limitations section.
Pass when limitations and conditions are explicitly stated.

steps.title: Confirm the signing actuary holds sufficient authority
sop: Check the actuarial authority matrix for the initiative size.
Confirm the signing actuary meets the required authority level.
Escalate to a higher authority where the threshold is not met.
Done when the signing actuary meets the required authority level.
verify: Compare the signing actuary level against the authority matrix.
Pass when the signer meets the threshold for the initiative size.

steps.title: Cite the exact business case model version in the memo
sop: Record the business case model version and date in the memo.
Confirm the assumptions signed match that version exactly.
Reissue the memo if the model version changes afterwards.
Done when the memo cites the exact model version and date.
verify: Compare the memo model citation against the business case version.
Pass when the versions are identical.

steps.title: Sign and file the memo against the business case
sop: Sign the memo and record the sign-off date.
File it in the SharePoint sign-off folder linked to the business case.
Notify the business case owner that sign-off is complete.
Done when the signed memo is filed and linked.
verify: Retrieve the signed memo and compare its figures against the case.
Pass when every signed figure matches the business case.

generic.Defined scope/population: The business case pack presented to the Investment Review Board including scenarios and actuarial sign-off.
generic.In-scope period: The board cycle in which the case is tabled, bounded by the board calendar pre-read deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack contains case, scenarios, sign-off, recommendation, requested funding, and requested decision.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The requested funding figure in the pack equals the investment estimate total in the business case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pack lodged in the board portal with a lodgement timestamp and the session record filed in SharePoint.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Board requests for further analysis captured as actions with owners and due dates.
generic.Test population: Every pack component and every question raised in the board session.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the pack was lodged after the pre-read deadline or a required component is absent.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or incomplete packs are deferred to the next board cycle rather than tabled partially.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The presentation is accepted when questions, answers, and follow-up actions are recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Board portal lodgement record, SharePoint session note, and the PPM tool action entries.

steps.title: Assemble the board pack with case, scenarios, and sign-off
sop: Collect the business case, scenario analysis, and actuarial sign-off memo.
Confirm all three cite the same business case version.
Assemble them into the board pack with a contents page.
Done when the pack contains all three components at matching versions.
verify: Compare the version citations across the three components.
Pass when all three cite the same business case version.

steps.title: State the recommendation, funding requested, and decision sought
sop: State the recommendation explicitly on the pack cover.
State the funding amount requested and its phasing.
State the decision the board is asked to make.
Done when all three statements appear on the pack cover.
verify: Compare the requested funding against the investment estimate total.
Pass when the requested figure matches the estimate.

steps.title: Lodge the pack by the board calendar pre-read deadline
sop: Upload the pack to the board portal for the scheduled session.
Confirm the lodgement timestamp precedes the pre-read deadline.
Notify board members that the pack is available.
Done when the pack is lodged before the pre-read deadline.
verify: Compare the lodgement timestamp against the deadline.
Pass when lodgement precedes the deadline.

steps.title: Present the case to the Investment Review Board
sop: Present the case, the scenario range, and the actuarial position.
Answer board questions directly and note where an answer is deferred.
Confirm the board understands the requested decision.
Done when the case has been presented and questions taken.
verify: Check the session record for the presentation and question log.
Pass when the presentation is recorded with questions captured.

steps.title: Record questions and the answers given
sop: Record each board question with the answer given in session.
Mark answers that were deferred for follow-up.
File the question and answer log with the session note.
Done when every question has a recorded answer or deferral.
verify: Filter the question log for questions with no answer or deferral.
Pass when no question is left unrecorded.

steps.title: Capture board requests for further analysis as actions
sop: List each board request for further analysis.
Assign an owner and a due date to each request.
Load the actions into the PPM tool against the initiative.
Done when every board request is an owned action with a date.
verify: Filter the action list for blank owners or due dates.
Pass when every board request has an owner and a due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The delivery cost, timeline, and resource requirements quantified across every delivery workstream.
generic.In-scope period: The delivery period from workstream start to launch, including filing approval windows.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each workstream carries a cost estimate, estimating team, role-level FTE by period, and confidence level.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of workstream cost estimates equals the total delivery cost quoted in the business case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Estimate workbook versioned in SharePoint with the Jira Align capacity extract date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Resource gaps against current capacity flagged with the resourcing action and the owner.
generic.Test population: Every workstream estimate and every role-period FTE entry.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any workstream estimate has no named owning team or resources are quoted as a single total.
generic.Exception handling path: Unowned estimates are referred to the delivery function for ownership before the estimate is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The estimate is accepted when a role-level FTE profile by period exists with named estimating teams.
generic.Evidence location: PPM tool estimate record, the Excel resource profile, and the Jira Align capacity view.

steps.title: Break delivery into workstreams with named estimating teams
sop: Break the delivery into workstreams such as product, pricing, configuration, and filings.
Name the team responsible for estimating each workstream.
Send each team the scope they are estimating against.
Done when every workstream has a named estimating team and scope.
verify: Filter the workstream list for blank estimating teams.
Pass when every workstream names an estimating team.

steps.title: Collect cost estimates per workstream
sop: Collect the cost estimate from each estimating team.
Record the basis and any assumptions behind each estimate.
Sum the workstream estimates into a delivery cost total.
Done when every workstream has a returned cost estimate.
verify: Sum the workstream estimates against the recorded total.
Pass when the components reconcile to the total.

steps.title: Build the timeline showing the critical path
sop: Sequence the workstream activities with their durations and dependencies.
Include the filing approval windows in the sequence.
Identify and mark the critical path activities.
Done when the timeline shows the critical path including filing windows.
verify: Read the timeline for marked critical path activities.
Pass when the critical path is identified and includes filing windows.

steps.title: Express resources as role-level FTE by period
sop: Convert each workstream estimate into named roles and FTE by period.
Avoid quoting resources as a single total effort figure.
Record the role names using the standard role taxonomy.
Done when the resource profile shows roles and FTE by period.
verify: Inspect the resource profile for role rows and period columns.
Pass when resources are expressed by role and period, not a single total.

steps.title: Test the requirement against current capacity in Jira Align
sop: Pull the current team capacity by role and period from Jira Align.
Compare the resource requirement against available capacity.
Flag each gap with the resourcing action and an owner.
Done when every capacity gap is flagged with an action.
verify: Filter the comparison for periods where demand exceeds capacity.
Pass when every such period carries a flagged action.

steps.title: State the confidence level and variance drivers
sop: State the confidence level of the overall estimate.
List the main drivers of variance in the estimate.
Record the range implied by those drivers.
Done when confidence level and variance drivers are stated.
verify: Read the estimate cover for the confidence statement.
Pass when a confidence level and named variance drivers are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approval decision and funding allocation recorded against the initiative in the project register.
generic.In-scope period: The approval cycle in which the decision was minuted and the funding allocated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision outcome, decision date, approving body, funding allocation, cost code, and conditions are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register funding allocation equals the amount stated in the approval minute exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Register entry retained with update timestamp and linked to the approved business case version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approval conditions captured as tracked register items with owners and due dates.
generic.Test population: The register entry fields and the approval minute for the initiative.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the allocated amount differs from the approved funding figure or the cost code is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Amount mismatches are corrected against the minute before the register entry is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The record is accepted when decision, date, body, and funding allocation are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: PPM tool project register entry plus the ERP general ledger cost code assignment.

steps.title: Extract the decision details from the approval minute
sop: Read the approval minute and record the decision outcome and date.
Record the approving body and the funding amount with its phasing.
List the conditions attached to the approval.
Done when the decision details are captured from the minute.
verify: Compare the captured details against the minute text.
Pass when the captured details match the minute exactly.

steps.title: Record the decision outcome, date, and body in the register
sop: Open the initiative in the PPM project register.
Enter the decision outcome, decision date, and approving body.
Save so the update timestamp is captured.
Done when the three decision fields are populated.
verify: Read the register decision fields on screen.
Pass when outcome, date, and body are all populated.

steps.title: Enter the funding allocation matching the minute
sop: Enter the funding allocation figure exactly as stated in the minute.
Enter the phasing where funding is released in tranches.
Re-check the figure against the minute before saving.
Done when the allocation matches the minute figure.
verify: Compare the register allocation against the minute amount.
Pass when the two figures are identical.

steps.title: Record the approved cost code or budget line
sop: Obtain the approved cost code or budget line from the ERP general ledger.
Record it against the register entry.
Confirm the code is open and available for the funding period.
Done when the cost code is recorded and confirmed open.
verify: Check the recorded cost code exists and is open in the ERP.
Pass when the code resolves and is available.

steps.title: Capture approval conditions as tracked items
sop: Load each condition from the minute as a tracked register item.
Assign an owner and a due date to each condition.
Set each condition to open for tracking to closure.
Done when every condition is a tracked item with an owner.
verify: Count tracked conditions against the conditions in the minute.
Pass when the counts match with none omitted.

steps.title: Link the register entry to the approved business case
sop: Attach or link the approved business case version to the register entry.
Confirm the linked version is the one the board approved.
Save the entry and record the completion date.
Done when the register entry links to the approved business case version.
verify: Follow the register link to the business case.
Pass when the linked version is the approved version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The revised business case resubmitted for approval after the board required additional analysis.
generic.In-scope period: The resubmission cycle from revision completion to lodgement for the scheduled committee date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cover note, revised version number and date, prior request mapping, and decision cycle record are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cover note request count equals the count of prior board requests recorded in the minute.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Resubmission pack lodged in the board portal with a version differing from the original submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Prior conditions answered only by assertion logged and reworked with supporting analysis.
generic.Test population: Every prior board request and every condition attached to the original decision.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any prior condition is unaddressed or the resubmission replaces rather than follows the first cycle.
generic.Exception handling path: Unaddressed conditions block lodgement until the supporting analysis is produced.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Resubmission is accepted when the cover note maps each prior request to its response.
generic.Evidence location: Board portal resubmission lodgement plus the PPM tool decision cycle history.

steps.title: List the prior board requests and conditions
sop: Read the original board minute and list every request and condition.
Record where in the revised case each is addressed.
Flag any request with no corresponding response.
Done when every prior request is listed with its response location.
verify: Filter the list for requests with no response location.
Pass when no prior request is left unmapped.

steps.title: Test each response for supporting analysis
sop: Check each response is supported by analysis rather than assertion.
Rework responses that assert a conclusion without evidence.
Record the supporting analysis reference against each response.
Done when every response cites supporting analysis.
verify: Read each response for its analysis reference.
Pass when no response rests on assertion alone.

steps.title: Confirm the revised version differs from the original
sop: Check the revised business case version number and date.
Confirm both differ from the originally submitted version.
Correct the versioning where they do not.
Done when the revised version and date differ from the original.
verify: Compare the revised version and date against the original submission.
Pass when both differ.

steps.title: Write the cover note mapping requests to responses
sop: Write a cover note listing each prior request and where it is addressed.
Include page or section references so the board can find each response.
Note requests the team disputes with the reasoned response.
Done when the cover note maps every prior request to a response.
verify: Count cover note entries against the prior request list.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Lodge the resubmission for a scheduled committee date
sop: Identify the next scheduled committee date with capacity.
Lodge the pack in the board portal before the pre-read deadline.
Confirm the committee secretary has accepted the item onto the agenda.
Done when the pack is lodged for a scheduled date within the deadline.
verify: Compare the lodgement timestamp against the pre-read deadline.
Pass when lodgement precedes the deadline for a scheduled date.

steps.title: Record the resubmission as a second decision cycle
sop: Create a second decision cycle entry on the PPM initiative record.
Retain the original decision cycle rather than overwriting it.
Link the second cycle to the revised business case version.
Done when both decision cycles exist in the initiative history.
verify: Open the initiative decision history.
Pass when both the original and resubmission cycles are retained.

generic.Defined scope/population: The investment committee funding decision for the initiative including amount, phasing, and conditions.
generic.In-scope period: The committee cycle in which the funding decision is taken and communicated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Minute records approved amount, phasing, conditions, attendee list, quorum, and recusals.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved amount sits within the committee delegated authority limit for the initiative size.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Minuted decision filed in the board portal with the decision date and communicated within the agreed timeframe.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Amounts exceeding delegated authority logged with the escalation to the higher approval body.
generic.Test population: The funding decision minute and the delegated authority matrix for the amount involved.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approved amount exceeds the committee delegated authority limit or quorum is not recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Over-limit approvals are escalated to the higher authority before any funding is drawn.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval is accepted when the minute records amount, conditions, and quorum.
generic.Evidence location: Board portal minute plus the PPM tool initiative funding decision record.

steps.title: Confirm the delegated authority limit for the amount
sop: Retrieve the delegated authority matrix from the governance library.
Look up the committee limit for the requested funding amount.
Escalate before the meeting where the amount exceeds the limit.
Done when the authority position for the amount is confirmed.
verify: Compare the requested amount against the committee limit.
Pass when the request sits within the limit or the escalation is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm quorum and record the attendee list
sop: Check attendance against the committee quorum requirement.
Record the full attendee list in the minute.
Defer the decision where quorum is not met.
Done when quorum is confirmed and attendees are recorded.
verify: Compare the attendee count against the quorum threshold.
Pass when quorum is met and the attendee list is recorded.

steps.title: Record conflicts of interest and recusals
sop: Ask members to declare any interest in the initiative.
Record any member recused from the decision.
Confirm recused members took no part in the vote.
Done when every recusal is recorded in the minute.
verify: Read the minute recusal section.
Pass when every declared conflict shows a recorded recusal.

steps.title: Take the funding decision with amount, phasing, and conditions
sop: Put the funding request to the committee for decision.
Record the approved amount and its phasing across periods.
Record every condition attached to the approval.
Done when the minute states amount, phasing, and conditions.
verify: Read the minute decision paragraph.
Pass when amount, phasing, and conditions are all stated.

steps.title: Verify the approved amount against the authority limit
sop: Compare the approved amount against the committee delegated limit.
Escalate immediately where the approval exceeds the limit.
Record the authority check result against the decision.
Done when the authority check is recorded for the approved amount.
verify: Read the authority check result against the matrix.
Pass when the approved amount is within the committee limit.

steps.title: Communicate and record the decision within the agreed timeframe
sop: Record the decision on the PPM initiative record with the minute reference.
Communicate the decision to the initiative owner and Finance.
Complete both within the timeframe set in the governance procedure.
Done when the decision is recorded and communicated within the timeframe.
verify: Compare the recording and communication dates against the decision date.
Pass when both fall within the agreed timeframe.

generic.Defined scope/population: The funding availability confirmation from Finance for the requested amount and its multi-year phasing.
generic.In-scope period: The full spend profile including any financial years the funding crosses.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Confirmation names the budget line or cost centre, amount, phasing, and any conditional availability.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Uncommitted budget on the named line equals or exceeds the requested funding amount.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written Finance confirmation dated and attached to the business case in SharePoint before committee.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Shortfalls or conditional availability logged with the agreed mitigation and its owner.
generic.Test population: Every year of the requested spend profile and the budget line it draws from.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if uncommitted budget does not cover the request or the confirmation is undated.
generic.Exception handling path: Shortfalls are escalated to the Finance business partner for a funding source decision before committee.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation is accepted when a written Finance confirmation is attached and dated before committee.
generic.Evidence location: ERP general ledger budget line extract plus the SharePoint business case folder confirmation.

steps.title: Extract the uncommitted budget from the ERP
sop: Query the ERP general ledger for the budget line and its commitments.
Calculate the uncommitted balance available for the initiative.
Record the extract date and the query used.
Done when the uncommitted budget position is extracted and dated.
verify: Compare the uncommitted balance against the requested amount.
Pass when the balance covers the request or the shortfall is quantified.

steps.title: Build the multi-year spend profile
sop: Lay out the requested spend by financial year from the investment estimate.
Mark the years where the spend crosses a financial year boundary.
Record the annual amounts in the confirmation request.
Done when the spend profile shows the amount per financial year.
verify: Sum the annual amounts against the total request.
Pass when the annual profile reconciles to the total.

steps.title: Request written confirmation from Finance
sop: Send Finance the requested amount, phasing, and multi-year profile.
Ask Finance to confirm availability and name the budget line or cost centre.
Set a response date ahead of the committee pre-read deadline.
Done when the confirmation request is sent with a response date.
verify: Check the request covers amount, phasing, and every year of spend.
Pass when all three are included in the request.

steps.title: Check the confirmation names the budget line and covers all years
sop: Read the Finance confirmation for the budget line or cost centre name.
Confirm it covers every financial year in the spend profile.
Return the confirmation for completion where a year is omitted.
Done when the confirmation names the line and covers all years.
verify: Compare the confirmation coverage against the spend profile years.
Pass when no year in the profile is uncovered.

steps.title: Document shortfalls and conditional availability
sop: Record any shortfall or condition Finance attaches to availability.
Agree the mitigation with Finance and record the owner.
Load the mitigation into the PPM tool as a tracked item.
Done when every shortfall or condition has a recorded mitigation.
verify: Filter shortfalls and conditions for missing mitigations.
Pass when every one carries a mitigation and an owner.

steps.title: Attach the dated confirmation to the business case
sop: Save the written confirmation to the SharePoint business case folder.
Attach it to the business case pack before it goes to committee.
Record the confirmation date on the business case cover.
Done when the dated confirmation is attached before committee.
verify: Compare the attachment date against the committee submission date.
Pass when the confirmation is attached and dated before submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: All superseded roadmap versions requiring archive with their change rationale for the audit trail.
generic.In-scope period: The effective date range each archived roadmap version was current for.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each archived version carries a version number, effective date range, change rationale, and retention class.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived version count equals the count of superseded versions in the roadmap tool history.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fixed snapshots retained in the document management repository with archive timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Versions archived without a rationale logged and completed before the archive is closed.
generic.Test population: Every superseded roadmap version in the roadmap tool version history.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any archived roadmap is stored as an editable live document or lacks a change rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Editable archives are replaced with fixed snapshots and the live link removed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archiving is accepted when an immutable snapshot and rationale exist for each superseded version.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository roadmap archive plus the SharePoint archive index.

steps.title: List superseded versions from the roadmap tool history
sop: Open the roadmap tool version history and list superseded versions.
Record the version number and the effective date range for each.
Confirm the list against the published roadmap announcements.
Done when every superseded version is listed with its date range.
verify: Compare the list against the roadmap tool history entries.
Pass when no superseded version is omitted.

steps.title: Export each version as a fixed snapshot
sop: Export each superseded version as a fixed-format snapshot.
Confirm the snapshot cannot be edited after export.
Name the file with the version number and date range.
Done when every superseded version exists as a fixed snapshot.
verify: Open a sample snapshot and attempt to edit it.
Pass when the snapshot is not editable.

steps.title: Write the change rationale for each version
sop: For each superseded version record why the roadmap changed.
Reference the review or change request that drove the change.
Store the rationale note alongside the snapshot.
Done when every archived version has a change rationale.
verify: Filter the archive index for versions with no rationale.
Pass when no archived version is missing its rationale.

steps.title: Upload snapshots and rationales to the repository
sop: Upload each snapshot and its rationale to the roadmap archive folder.
Record the effective date range in the entry metadata.
Remove any link pointing at the live roadmap from the archive entry.
Done when every version is archived with metadata and no live link.
verify: Inspect archive entries for links to the live roadmap.
Pass when no archive entry links to an editable roadmap.

steps.title: Apply the governance record retention class
sop: Look up the retention period for product governance records.
Apply that retention class to the archive folder and entries.
Record the disposal date on each archive entry.
Done when the retention class is applied to every archived version.
verify: Inspect the retention property on a sample of archive entries.
Pass when the class matches the governance retention schedule.

steps.title: Test point-in-time retrieval from the archive index
sop: Ask a reviewer to retrieve the roadmap as it stood at a chosen date.
Confirm the index returns the correct version for that date.
Correct the date range metadata where retrieval is wrong.
Done when point-in-time retrieval returns the correct version.
verify: Run retrieval tests for several dates across the archive.
Pass when each test returns the version current at that date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The quarterly roadmap review reprioritising items using performance data and market shifts.
generic.In-scope period: The quarter under review plus the forward horizon being reprioritised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each item carries actual versus committed KPI data, change decision, reason for change, and new priority.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items moved, deferred, or dropped plus items unchanged equals the total roadmap item count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review pack and minute filed in SharePoint with the new roadmap version dated to the review.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with no available performance data logged with the reason and the data owner.
generic.Test population: Every in-flight roadmap item and every change decision made at the review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any change lacks a recorded reason or the reprioritisation used a different scoring framework.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreasoned changes are referred back to the proposer before the roadmap version is incremented.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The review is accepted when a new roadmap version is dated to the review with change reasons recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Product roadmap tool version history, the Power BI performance pack, and the PPM tool status data.

steps.title: Build the actual versus committed KPI view in Power BI
sop: Pull actual KPI performance for each in-flight roadmap item.
Place actuals alongside the KPIs committed at the last review.
Publish the comparison view as the review input.
Done when the actual versus committed view is published.
verify: Open the Power BI view and check both actual and committed columns.
Pass when every in-flight item shows both figures.

steps.title: Summarise market shifts with sources
sop: Summarise competitor moves and market changes since the last review.
Cite the source and date for each shift recorded.
State the implication for the affected roadmap items.
Done when market shifts are summarised with cited sources.
verify: Filter the market shift summary for entries with no source.
Pass when every shift cites a dated source.

steps.title: Re-score the roadmap using the original framework
sop: Apply the same scoring framework used at the original prioritisation.
Update value, effort, risk, and strategic scores with new information.
Avoid changing the framework or weights mid-cycle.
Done when every item is re-scored using the original framework.
verify: Compare the framework and weights against the original prioritisation.
Pass when the framework and weights are unchanged.

steps.title: Record the reason for every move, deferral, or drop
sop: List each item moved, deferred, or dropped at the review.
Record the reason for the change against each item.
Confirm the reason references performance data or a market shift.
Done when every changed item carries a recorded reason.
verify: Filter changed items for blank reasons.
Pass when no changed item is left without a reason.

steps.title: Minute the review attendance and decisions
sop: Record attendance at the quarterly review.
Minute the reprioritisation decisions taken.
File the minute with the review pack in SharePoint.
Done when attendance and decisions are minuted and filed.
verify: Read the minute for the attendance list and decision table.
Pass when both are present in the filed minute.

steps.title: Increment the roadmap version to the review date
sop: Apply the agreed changes in the roadmap tool.
Increment the roadmap version and date it to the review.
Confirm the prior version is retained in the version history.
Done when the new version is dated to the review and the prior version retained.
verify: Open the roadmap version history.
Pass when the new version carries the review date and the prior version remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: Written commitment from every delivery function against the published roadmap version.
generic.In-scope period: The roadmap horizon being committed to for the current published version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each commitment names the function, the roadmap version, the items committed, and any constraint.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Committed items across functions cover every item on the published roadmap or the gaps are recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Commitment records filed in SharePoint and referenced on the PPM roadmap record with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Functions unable to commit logged with the constraint, affected items, and the escalation route.
generic.Test population: Every delivery function and every item on the published roadmap version.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any commitment is recorded against a superseded roadmap version or a function has not responded.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved disagreements are escalated to the Product Governance Committee with a decision date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Alignment is accepted when written commitment exists from every delivery function against the published version.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint commitment folder plus the PPM tool roadmap record commitment entries.

steps.title: Circulate the published roadmap version to delivery functions
sop: Send the published roadmap version to IT, actuarial, operations, distribution, and compliance.
State the items each function is being asked to commit to.
Set the response deadline and the commitment format.
Done when all five functions hold the published version and the request.
verify: Check the circulation record covers all five functions.
Pass when no delivery function is omitted.

steps.title: Collect written commitments citing the roadmap version
sop: Collect each function's written commitment.
Confirm each cites the specific roadmap version and the items committed.
Return commitments that cite a superseded version for reissue.
Done when every function has committed against the published version.
verify: Compare the version cited in each commitment against the published version.
Pass when every commitment cites the published version.

steps.title: Record constraints where a function cannot commit
sop: Record the constraint each non-committing function raises.
Name the roadmap items affected by each constraint.
Quantify the constraint in capacity or timing terms.
Done when every non-commitment carries a named constraint and affected items.
verify: Filter non-commitments for blank constraints or affected items.
Pass when no non-commitment is left unexplained.

steps.title: Test commitments against the capacity mapping
sop: Compare each commitment against the capacity mapping for that function.
Flag commitments that exceed the mapped capacity.
Raise flagged commitments with the function for confirmation or revision.
Done when every commitment is tested against the capacity mapping.
verify: Compare committed effort against mapped capacity per function.
Pass when no commitment exceeds mapped capacity without confirmation.

steps.title: Escalate unresolved disagreements to the governance committee
sop: List disagreements that could not be resolved with the function.
Table each at the Product Governance Committee with a decision date.
Record the escalation against the roadmap record.
Done when every unresolved disagreement is escalated with a decision date.
verify: Check the committee agenda against the unresolved list.
Pass when every unresolved disagreement is tabled with a date.

steps.title: File commitments against the roadmap record
sop: Save all commitments and constraints to the SharePoint commitment folder.
Link them to the PPM roadmap record for the published version.
Record the commitment completion date.
Done when commitments are filed and linked to the roadmap version.
verify: Open the roadmap record and retrieve the commitment set.
Pass when every function commitment is retrievable against the version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved product concepts from the pipeline register plus in-flight initiatives from the project register merged into one roadmap.
generic.In-scope period: The roadmap horizon covering the current and forward planning quarters.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each roadmap item carries LOB, owner, target quarter, strategic pillar, and source register reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consolidated item count reconciles to the sum of source register counts with merges explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consolidated roadmap versioned in the roadmap tool with the source extract dates recorded in Excel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Merged duplicate items logged with the source IDs merged and the reason.
generic.Test population: Every approved concept and every in-flight initiative in the source registers.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any approved concept or in-flight initiative is missing, or a duplicate item represents one initiative twice.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing items are added and duplicates merged before the consolidated roadmap is baselined.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consolidation is accepted when the roadmap contains every approved concept and in-flight initiative once.
generic.Evidence location: Product roadmap tool consolidated version plus the Excel reconciliation against both source registers.

steps.title: Extract approved concepts from the pipeline register
sop: Run the pipeline register report filtered to approved concepts.
Export concept ID, LOB, owner, and next milestone into Excel.
Record the extract date on the source tab.
Done when the approved concept population is extracted.
verify: Compare the extract count against the register approved count.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Extract in-flight initiatives from the project register
sop: Run the project register report filtered to in-flight initiatives.
Export initiative ID, status, LOB, owner, and target quarter.
Record the extract date on the same source tab.
Done when the in-flight initiative population is extracted.
verify: Compare the extract count against the register in-flight count.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Merge duplicates and record the merges
sop: Match concepts against initiatives to find items representing the same work.
Merge duplicates into a single roadmap item.
Record the source IDs merged and the reason for the merge.
Done when duplicates are merged with the merge recorded.
verify: Run a duplicate check across the merged item list.
Pass when no roadmap item represents the same initiative twice.

steps.title: Populate LOB, owner, quarter, and pillar consistently
sop: Populate LOB, owner, target quarter, and strategic pillar on every item.
Use the same taxonomy values across items from both sources.
Resolve values that differ between the two source registers.
Done when every item carries the four fields consistently.
verify: Filter the roadmap for blank or off-taxonomy values in the four fields.
Pass when no item is missing or inconsistent on any field.

steps.title: Load the consolidated set into the roadmap tool
sop: Create each consolidated item in the product roadmap tool.
Record the source register reference on each roadmap item.
Version the consolidated roadmap.
Done when the consolidated set exists in the roadmap tool with source references.
verify: Compare roadmap tool item count against the consolidated Excel list.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Reconcile the roadmap against both source registers
sop: Compare the roadmap item count against the sum of source counts less merges.
Investigate and explain any remaining difference.
Record the reconciliation on the source tab.
Done when the reconciliation is complete with differences explained.
verify: Read the reconciliation difference figure.
Pass when the difference is zero or fully explained by recorded merges.

generic.Defined scope/population: Readiness dependencies across IT, operations, and distribution mapped to every roadmap launch.
generic.In-scope period: The launch window for each roadmap item plus the filing approval lead time preceding it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each dependency carries a required-by date, owning team, type, and at-risk flag where applicable.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Launches with logged dependencies equal the total launch count on the roadmap.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dependency log retained in the PPM tool and Jira Align with the log date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dependencies at risk of missing their required-by date flagged for escalation with an owner.
generic.Test population: Every roadmap launch and every logged dependency entry.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any roadmap launch has no logged readiness dependency or an entry lacks a date and owning team.
generic.Exception handling path: Launches with no dependencies are challenged and completed before the roadmap is baselined.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mapping is accepted when every dependency entry carries a required-by date and owning team.
generic.Evidence location: PPM tool dependency log, the Jira Align dependency view, and the Excel dependency workbook.

steps.title: List every roadmap launch requiring dependency mapping
sop: Extract the launches from the roadmap for the planning horizon.
Create a dependency mapping row per launch.
Confirm the launch list with the Insurance Product Dev Lead.
Done when every launch has a dependency mapping row.
verify: Compare mapping rows against the roadmap launch count.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Log IT readiness dependencies per launch
sop: Identify the system configuration and integration work each launch needs.
Log each as a dependency with the owning IT team.
Set the required-by date working back from the launch date.
Done when every launch has its IT dependencies logged.
verify: Filter launches for those with no IT dependency.
Pass when every launch has at least one IT dependency or a recorded reason.

steps.title: Log operations and distribution readiness dependencies
sop: Identify servicing, billing, claims, and channel enablement dependencies.
Log each with the owning operations or distribution team.
Set the required-by date for each dependency.
Done when operations and distribution dependencies are logged per launch.
verify: Filter launches for missing operations or distribution dependencies.
Pass when every launch has both types logged or a recorded reason.

steps.title: Log regulatory filing dependencies per jurisdiction
sop: List the jurisdictions each launch requires a filing in.
Log a filing dependency per jurisdiction with its approval lead time.
Set the required-by date so approval precedes launch.
Done when filing dependencies are logged per jurisdiction with lead times.
verify: Compare filing required-by dates against launch dates and lead times.
Pass when every filing dependency leaves the required lead time.

steps.title: Record inter-item dependencies as predecessor links
sop: Identify roadmap items that depend on other roadmap items.
Create predecessor links in Jira Align rather than notes.
Remove notes that duplicate a now-explicit link.
Done when every inter-item dependency is an explicit predecessor link.
verify: Open the Jira Align dependency view for note-only dependencies.
Pass when no inter-item dependency exists only as free text.

steps.title: Flag dependencies at risk of missing their date
sop: Compare each dependency required-by date against the owning team plan.
Flag dependencies at risk of being late.
Escalate each flagged dependency with an owner and a decision date.
Done when every at-risk dependency is flagged and escalated.
verify: Filter the dependency log for at-risk entries without an escalation.
Pass when every at-risk dependency carries an escalation owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All roadmap change requests received through the intake workflow in the current cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The disposition window defined in the change procedure from request receipt to decision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each request carries requester, date, item affected, impact on scope, timing, cost, and dependencies.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved change count applied to the roadmap equals the approved count in the change log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change log retained in the roadmap tool with each decision date and approver recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected requests closed with a recorded rationale rather than left open.
generic.Test population: Every roadmap change request logged in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any request is open beyond the defined disposition timeframe or approved at the wrong authority level.
generic.Exception handling path: Overdue requests are escalated to the Insurance Product Manager for immediate disposition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Change management is accepted when the roadmap version reflects every approved change request.
generic.Evidence location: Product roadmap tool change log plus the PPM tool impact records and SharePoint decision evidence.

steps.title: Log every change request with requester and affected item
sop: Log each incoming change request in the roadmap tool change log.
Record the requester, request date, and the roadmap item affected.
Reject informal requests that do not go through intake.
Done when every request is logged with requester, date, and item.
verify: Filter the change log for blank requester, date, or item.
Pass when no request is missing any of the three.

steps.title: Assess impact on scope, timing, cost, and dependencies
sop: For each request assess the impact on scope, timing, and cost.
Identify dependent items affected by the change.
Record the assessed impact against the request.
Done when every request carries a four-dimension impact assessment.
verify: Filter requests for missing impact dimensions.
Pass when every request has all four impacts assessed.

steps.title: Route each request to the correct authority level
sop: Match the assessed impact size against the change authority thresholds.
Route each request to the authority level its impact requires.
Escalate requests that exceed the local authority level.
Done when every request is routed to the correct authority.
verify: Compare each approval authority against the impact threshold.
Pass when no request was approved below its required authority.

steps.title: Record the approve or reject decision with rationale
sop: Record the decision, decision maker, and date on each request.
Write the rationale for approvals and rejections alike.
Close rejected requests rather than leaving them open.
Done when every request has a decision, date, and rationale.
verify: Filter the change log for open requests past the disposition timeframe.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Apply approved changes and increment the roadmap version
sop: Apply each approved change to the roadmap in the roadmap tool.
Increment the roadmap version after the changes are applied.
Record the change request references against the new version.
Done when the roadmap version reflects every approved change.
verify: Compare approved change count against changes visible in the new version.
Pass when every approved change appears in the roadmap version.

steps.title: Notify affected owners of applied changes
sop: Identify the owners of items affected by applied changes.
Notify each of the change and the new roadmap version.
Record the notification against the change request.
Done when every affected owner is notified.
verify: Compare the notification list against the affected item owners.
Pass when no affected owner is omitted.

generic.Defined scope/population: Roadmap items assessed against the capacity of product design, actuarial, and regulatory filing teams.
generic.In-scope period: The capacity planning periods covering the roadmap horizon being mapped.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each item carries an effort estimate in the capacity unit and each period carries a capacity figure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cumulative demand per period reconciles to the sum of item effort estimates falling in that period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Capacity mapping workbook versioned with the Jira Align capacity extract date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overloaded periods logged with the proposed response of defer, resource, or descope.
generic.Test population: Every roadmap item and every capacity period for the three delivery teams.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any roadmap item has no effort estimate in the capacity unit or an overload has no response.
generic.Exception handling path: Items without estimates are referred to the delivery team before the mapping is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mapping is accepted when demand versus capacity is shown period by period for each team.
generic.Evidence location: The Excel capacity mapping workbook plus the Jira Align capacity view and PPM tool item estimates.

steps.title: State available capacity per team per period
sop: Pull available capacity for product design, actuarial, and filing teams from Jira Align.
Express capacity per period in FTE or effort days consistently.
Record the extract date on the workbook source tab.
Done when capacity per team per period is stated in a single unit.
verify: Check capacity figures use the same unit across all three teams.
Pass when the unit is consistent and every period has a figure.

steps.title: Attach an effort estimate to every roadmap item
sop: Collect the effort estimate for each roadmap item from the delivery teams.
Convert estimates into the same unit as the capacity figures.
Chase items where no estimate has been provided.
Done when every roadmap item carries an effort estimate in the capacity unit.
verify: Filter roadmap items for blank or off-unit effort estimates.
Pass when no item is missing an estimate in the capacity unit.

steps.title: Add the actuarial effort view to the mapping
sop: Review the actuarial effort assumed for each roadmap item.
Adjust estimates where the actuarial work has been understated.
Record the adjusted actuarial effort in the mapping.
Done when the actuarial effort for every item is confirmed.
verify: Compare actuarial estimates against comparable past initiatives.
Pass when every item has a confirmed actuarial effort figure.

steps.title: Build the cumulative demand versus capacity view
sop: Spread each item effort across the periods it will consume.
Sum demand per period per team and place it against capacity.
Present the view period by period rather than item by item.
Done when cumulative demand versus capacity is shown per period.
verify: Sum item efforts per period against the demand row.
Pass when the demand row reconciles to the item efforts.

steps.title: Highlight and quantify overloaded periods
sop: Identify periods where demand exceeds capacity for any team.
Quantify the overload in the capacity unit.
Highlight the overloaded periods in the mapping view.
Done when every overloaded period is highlighted and quantified.
verify: Compare demand and capacity rows for each period.
Pass when every period with demand above capacity is highlighted.

steps.title: Record a proposed response for each overloaded period
sop: For each overloaded period propose defer, resource, or descope.
Name the items affected by the proposed response.
Assign an owner to take the response forward.
Done when every overloaded period has a proposed response and owner.
verify: Filter overloaded periods for missing responses.
Pass when no overloaded period is left without a proposed response.

generic.Defined scope/population: The roadmap backlog scored and ranked on value, effort, risk, and strategic fit criteria.
generic.In-scope period: The prioritisation cycle for the current roadmap planning horizon.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every backlog item carries a value, effort, risk, and strategic score plus any override justification.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The published backlog order matches the scorecard ranking apart from justified overrides.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring workbook versioned in SharePoint with the delivery team effort estimate source recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual overrides of the score-based ranking logged with a recorded justification and approver.
generic.Test population: Every backlog item and every score cell across the four criteria.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any backlog item is missing one of the four scores or an override has no justification.
generic.Exception handling path: Unjustified overrides are reverted to the scorecard order before the backlog is published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prioritisation is accepted when backlog order matches the scorecard ranking apart from justified overrides.
