generic.Evidence location: The Excel scoring workbook plus the product roadmap tool backlog order.

steps.title: Load the backlog into the scoring workbook
sop: Export the roadmap backlog from the roadmap tool into Excel.
Create one scoring row per backlog item.
Record the extract date on the source tab.
Done when every backlog item has a scoring row.
verify: Compare workbook rows against the roadmap tool backlog count.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Score value using the business case benefit figure
sop: For items with a business case use its benefit figure as the value input.
For items without a case record the estimated benefit and its basis.
Convert benefits into the value score using the defined scale.
Done when every item has a value score referencing its benefit figure.
verify: Trace value scores back to the business case benefit figures.
Pass when every item with a case uses its recorded benefit.

steps.title: Take the effort score from the delivery team estimate
sop: Collect the effort estimate for each item from the delivery team.
Convert the estimate into the effort score using the defined scale.
Reject effort scores assigned by the product team without a delivery estimate.
Done when every effort score derives from a delivery team estimate.
verify: Check each effort score cites a delivery team estimate.
Pass when no effort score is product-team assigned without an estimate.

steps.title: Score risk and strategic fit for every item
sop: Score delivery and market risk for each item using the defined scale.
Score strategic fit against the named strategic pillar.
Complete every cell so no item is partially scored.
Done when risk and strategic scores are complete for every item.
verify: Filter the workbook for blank risk or strategic score cells.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Produce the ranked backlog from the scoring formula
sop: Calculate the weighted total for each item using the workbook formula.
Sort the backlog by the calculated total.
Avoid reordering the list manually.
Done when the ranked backlog is produced by the formula.
verify: Recalculate and compare the order against the published backlog.
Pass when the two orders agree apart from flagged overrides.

steps.title: Flag and justify any manual override
sop: Identify any item positioned differently from the scorecard rank.
Flag the override and record a written justification and approver.
Revert overrides that cannot be justified.
Done when every override is flagged with a justification.
verify: Compare the published order against the scorecard rank.
Pass when every difference carries a flagged justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: The finalised roadmap version distributed to the stakeholder audience on the roadmap stakeholder register.
generic.In-scope period: The publication window from version approval to the announcement and supersession of the prior version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Published roadmap carries approved version number, publication date, and audience permissions.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Distribution recipient count equals the roadmap stakeholder register count including partners in scope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Publication record and distribution list retained in SharePoint with the publication timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Access failures logged with the permission fix applied and the retest result.
generic.Test population: The published roadmap, the distribution list, and the externally shared version if any.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a superseded version is still presented as current or commercially sensitive detail appears externally.
generic.Exception handling path: Sensitive detail found externally triggers immediate withdrawal and reissue of a redacted version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Publication is accepted when the current approved version and publication date are visible to the audience.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint published roadmap location, the roadmap tool published version, and the Teams announcement.

steps.title: Confirm the approved roadmap version to publish
sop: Identify the roadmap version approved at the governance review.
Confirm the version number and approval date from the minute.
Set the publication date on the version record.
Done when the approved version and publication date are confirmed.
verify: Compare the version to publish against the approval minute.
Pass when the version matches the minuted approval.

steps.title: Build the distribution list from the stakeholder register
sop: Open the roadmap stakeholder register and extract the recipient list.
Include distribution partners where they are in scope for the roadmap.
Adjust for joiners and leavers since the last publication.
Done when the distribution list matches the register.
verify: Compare the distribution list count against the register count.
Pass when no register recipient is omitted.

steps.title: Produce a redacted version for external sharing
sop: Identify commercially sensitive detail such as pricing or margin data.
Remove that detail from the version shared outside the organisation.
Label the external version clearly as the external release.
Done when the external version carries no commercially sensitive detail.
verify: Review the external version against the sensitivity criteria.
Pass when no commercially sensitive detail remains.

steps.title: Publish to SharePoint and the roadmap tool
sop: Publish the approved version to the SharePoint roadmap location.
Set the roadmap tool version status to published.
Show the version number and publication date on the published view.
Done when the version is published in both locations with its metadata.
verify: Open the published roadmap and read the version and date.
Pass when both are visible on the published view.

steps.title: Mark the prior published version superseded
sop: Set the prior published version status to superseded.
Move it to the archive location at the same time as publication.
Confirm no location still presents it as current.
Done when the prior version is marked superseded and archived.
verify: Search the published locations for the prior version.
Pass when no superseded version is presented as current.

steps.title: Announce publication and test audience access
sop: Send the announcement with the roadmap link to the distribution list.
Ask a non-author account in the audience to open the link.
Fix permission failures and retest before closing.
Done when the audience can open the published roadmap.
verify: Open the published location from a non-author audience account.
Pass when the account can read the current approved roadmap.

generic.Defined scope/population: The roadmap adherence variance report comparing delivery against the baselined roadmap commitment for the period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period covered by the variance report with the PPM status data cut-off date recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each variance line carries committed item, delivered status, root cause, recovery action, and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report figures reconcile to the PPM tool status data as at the reporting date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report and committee minute filed in SharePoint with the reporting date and data cut-off recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material slippages logged with root cause, recovery action, and an accountable owner.
generic.Test population: Every committed roadmap item for the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the report figures do not reconcile to the PPM status data or a slippage has no root cause.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled figures are corrected against the PPM data before the report is tabled.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when tabled at the Product Governance Committee and the discussion is minuted.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI variance report, the PPM tool status data, and the SharePoint committee minute.

steps.title: Extract the baselined commitment for the period
sop: Retrieve the baselined roadmap commitment for the reporting period.
List the items committed with their baselined dates.
Record the baseline version used.
Done when the baselined commitment set is extracted.
verify: Compare the extracted set against the baselined roadmap version.
Pass when the set matches the baseline for the period.

steps.title: Pull the delivered status from the PPM tool
sop: Pull the current status for each committed item from the PPM tool.
Record the status data cut-off date.
Load the status data into the Power BI variance report.
Done when delivered status is loaded against every committed item.
verify: Compare the Power BI figures against the PPM status data.
Pass when the report reconciles to the PPM data at the cut-off.

steps.title: Separate approved descopes from unmanaged slippage
sop: Identify items removed by an approved change request.
Classify those as approved descopes rather than slippage.
Classify the remainder as slippage against commitment.
Done when every variance is classified as descope or slippage.
verify: Cross-check descoped items against the approved change log.
Pass when every descope is supported by an approved change request.

steps.title: Record root cause and recovery action for material slippage
sop: For each material slippage identify the root cause.
Agree a recovery action with the delivery owner.
Record the action with a named owner and a target date.
Done when every material slippage has a root cause and owned recovery action.
verify: Filter material slippages for missing root cause or recovery action.
Pass when no material slippage is left without either.

steps.title: Assemble the variance report for the committee
sop: Assemble the committed versus delivered comparison for the period.
Include the descope and slippage classification and recovery actions.
State the data cut-off date on the report cover.
Done when the report is assembled with the comparison and cut-off date.
verify: Read the report cover for the data cut-off date.
Pass when the report shows committed versus delivered against the baseline.

steps.title: Table the report and minute the discussion
sop: Table the variance report at the Product Governance Committee.
Record the discussion and any committee direction in the minute.
File the report and minute in the SharePoint governance folder.
Done when the report is tabled and the discussion minuted.
verify: Read the committee minute for the variance report item.
Pass when the tabling and discussion are recorded in the minute.

generic.Defined scope/population: The release sequence for roadmap items ordered against capacity, dependencies, and filing lead times.
generic.In-scope period: The release horizon covered by the sequence, including the filing submission windows preceding each launch.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each release carries a target date, predecessor links, capacity period, and filing lead time where applicable.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Releases sequenced into each period sit within the capacity available per the capacity mapping.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sequenced roadmap baselined in the roadmap tool with the delivery lead sign-off recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Releases that cannot be sequenced within capacity logged with the defer or descope decision.
generic.Test population: Every release in the sequence and every predecessor relationship.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any release is scheduled before its logged predecessor completes or filing lead time is ignored.
generic.Exception handling path: Sequencing conflicts are resolved with the delivery leads before the sequence is baselined.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The sequence is accepted when signed off by the delivery leads and baselined.
generic.Evidence location: Product roadmap tool sequenced version plus the PPM tool dependency log and Excel capacity mapping.

steps.title: Set target dates leaving the filing approval lead time
sop: For each release identify the required filing approval lead time.
Set the target launch date leaving that lead time after submission.
Record the submission date implied by the launch date.
Done when every release target date leaves its filing lead time.
verify: Compare the gap between submission and launch against the lead time.
Pass when every release leaves the required filing lead time.

steps.title: Order releases behind their logged predecessors
sop: Read the dependency log for each release predecessor link.
Sequence each release after its predecessors complete.
Resolve any circular dependency with the delivery leads.
Done when no release precedes a logged predecessor.
verify: Compare each release date against its predecessor completion date.
Pass when no release is scheduled before its predecessor completes.

steps.title: Fit releases within the capacity available per period
sop: Compare the sequenced release effort against the capacity mapping per period.
Move releases out of periods that would be overloaded.
Record defer or descope decisions where movement is not possible.
Done when the sequence fits within the capacity per period.
verify: Sum sequenced effort per period against the capacity figures.
Pass when no period exceeds its available capacity.

steps.title: Sequence multi-jurisdiction launches by filing approval timing
sop: Split multi-jurisdiction launches into per-jurisdiction release points.
Sequence each by its own filing approval timing.
Avoid treating a multi-jurisdiction launch as a single date.
Done when multi-jurisdiction launches are sequenced per jurisdiction.
verify: Inspect multi-jurisdiction items for per-jurisdiction release points.
Pass when no multi-jurisdiction launch carries a single blended date.

steps.title: Obtain delivery lead sign-off on the sequence
sop: Circulate the proposed sequence to the delivery leads.
Collect written sign-off or the constraint preventing it.
Rework the sequence where a lead cannot sign off.
Done when every delivery lead has signed off the sequence.
verify: Check the sign-off record covers every delivery lead.
Pass when no delivery lead sign-off is missing.

steps.title: Baseline the agreed release sequence
sop: Apply the agreed sequence in the roadmap tool.
Baseline the release dates so later change is measurable.
Record the baseline date and the sign-off reference.
Done when the sequence is baselined with its sign-off reference.
verify: Open the roadmap tool baseline for the sequence.
Pass when the baseline exists and matches the signed-off sequence.

generic.Defined scope/population: The roadmap adherence metric set measuring delivery against the baselined roadmap commitment.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period measured, with the metric refresh date recorded on the report.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each metric carries a written definition, calculation, source field, refresh date, and LOB and team breakdown.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Metric inputs reconcile to the PPM tool status field data for the same reporting date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Metric definitions and Power BI report version retained with the refresh date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics whose definition changed since the prior period logged with the change and its effect.
generic.Test population: Every adherence metric and every source field feeding it.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any metric is sourced from a manual spreadsheet rather than the system of record.
generic.Exception handling path: Manually sourced metrics are re-pointed at the PPM status fields before the metrics are published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Metrics are accepted when calculated against the baselined roadmap with a stated refresh date.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI adherence report, the PPM tool status fields, and the warehouse metric dataset.

steps.title: Point the metric calculation at the baselined roadmap
sop: Load the baselined roadmap commitment as the metric denominator.
Confirm the baseline used is not the latest revised version.
Record the baseline version on the metric definition sheet.
Done when the metrics measure against the baselined roadmap.
verify: Compare the metric baseline reference against the baselined version.
Pass when the metrics use the baseline, not the revised roadmap.

steps.title: Define the metric set with written calculations
sop: Define on-time delivery rate, scope delivered, and average slippage in days.
Write the calculation for each metric explicitly.
Check the definitions have not changed since the prior period.
Done when every metric has a written definition and calculation.
verify: Compare the definitions against the prior period definitions.
Pass when no definition has changed without a logged change note.

steps.title: Source the metric inputs from the PPM status fields
sop: Point each metric input at the PPM tool status fields.
Load the status data into the warehouse metric dataset.
Remove any manual spreadsheet feed from the metric pipeline.
Done when every metric input is sourced from the PPM status fields.
verify: Trace each metric input to its PPM source field.
Pass when no metric is sourced from a manual spreadsheet.

steps.title: Break the metrics down by LOB and delivery team
sop: Add LOB and delivery team dimensions to the metric dataset.
Build the Power BI views showing each metric by both dimensions.
Confirm the breakdowns sum back to the overall figure.
Done when every metric is available by LOB and delivery team.
verify: Sum the breakdown values against the overall metric.
Pass when the breakdowns reconcile to the total.

steps.title: Reconcile the metrics to the PPM data for the period
sop: Compare the calculated metrics against the raw PPM status data.
Investigate any difference beyond the agreed tolerance.
Correct the calculation where a difference is a defect.
Done when the metrics reconcile to the PPM data for the period.
verify: Read the reconciliation result for the reporting period.
Pass when the metrics agree with the PPM data within tolerance.

steps.title: Publish the metrics with a stated refresh date
sop: Publish the Power BI adherence report for the period.
State the refresh date and the baseline version on the report.
Notify the roadmap stakeholders that metrics are available.
Done when the metrics are published with a stated refresh date.
verify: Open the published report and read the refresh date and baseline.
Pass when both are shown on the report.
